main.pt: 两部分招股书的交付、更新与摘要规则
main.trap: 从业代表私收费与财报月寄陷阱
main.stem: Which of the following statements regarding a scholarship plan prospectus and its delivery to subscribers is correct?
main.zh: 关于奖学金计划招股书及其向认购人的交付，以下哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: It is updated monthly to reflect recent portfolio returns and only the four-page Plan Summary must be delivered to the subscriber.
opts.w: 更新频率与交付范围均错：招股书（prospectus）是每年续期（renewed annually），而非按月更新；且 Plan Summary 与 Detailed Plan Disclosure 两部分都必须交给认购人，不能只给摘要。

opts.t: It has a plain-language Plan Summary of up to four pages plus a Detailed Plan Disclosure, is renewed each year, and both parts go to every subscriber.
opts.w: 正确。招股书强制分为两部分：不超过 4 页、用平实语言（plain language）编写的 Plan Summary（计划摘要），以及数十页法律语言的 Detailed Plan Disclosure（详细计划披露）；招股书每年续期，销售时两部分都必须交付给认购人。

opts.t: It includes the audited annual financial statements and MRFP printed inside the enrollment package handed to every subscriber.
opts.w: 混淆「直接交付」与「引用并入」：年度审计财报、MRFP 与 IRC 年报是以引用方式并入招股书（incorporated by reference），放在 SEDAR+ 或官网供查阅，并不随招股书印刷交给认购人。

opts.t: A single generic Plan Summary covers all plans offered by the same investment fund manager, so the representative may hand out any version.
opts.w: 张冠李戴陷阱：每个在售计划都有各自独立的 Plan Summary，代表必须交付认购人所投资的那一个具体计划的 Plan Summary，不能混用。

main.pt: 招股书收据与CRA批准的真实含义
main.trap: 政府背书陷阱
main.stem: During a sales meeting, a prospective subscriber asks what it means that the provincial securities commission has issued a receipt for the scholarship plan's prospectus and the CRA has approved the plan. How must the dealing representative respond?
main.zh: 在销售面谈中，一位准认购人询问：省证监会对奖学金计划招股书发出收据（receipt）且加拿大税务局（CRA）已批准该计划，这意味着什么？从业代表必须如何回答？

opts.t: It means both agencies have checked the accuracy of the plan's financial projections and recommend it to families as a prudent, low-risk investment.
opts.w: 政府背书陷阱：证监会发出 receipt 和 CRA 批准绝不代表核实了披露内容的准确性，也不代表推荐该计划为审慎投资。声称监管机构对证券发表过意见属于违法行为。

opts.t: It means the plan is guaranteed by a federal crown corporation on the same basis as a bank deposit covered by CDIC.
opts.w: 政府担保与 CDIC 陷阱：奖学金计划不受任何政府担保，且奖学金计划机构不是 CDIC（加拿大存款保险公司）成员，不得让客户误以为受 CDIC 保护。

opts.t: It shows only that set requirements for sale in the province and for RESP registration were met; neither agency endorses, recommends or guarantees the plan.
opts.w: 正确。证监会发出 receipt（收据）是该省准许公开发售的前提，CRA 批准则涉及 RESP 注册资格；两者都只说明满足了特定监管要求，绝不构成对计划投资价值、披露准确性或管理层能力的背书、推荐或担保。

opts.t: It means the securities commission drafted the prospectus and supervises the daily portfolio trades through the SEDAR+ regulator portal.
opts.w: 职能混淆陷阱：招股书由计划管理人编写而非证监会撰写，且 SEDAR+ 只是一个免费公开的备案文件检索系统，不是监管交易的机构。

main.pt: 四张法定财报与净资产变动表的流入流出
main.trap: EAP 资金流向反转
main.stem: When reviewing a scholarship plan's audited annual financial statements, which item is recorded as an outflow (rather than an inflow) on the Statement of Changes in Net Assets?
main.zh: 在审阅奖学金计划经审计的年度财务报表时，以下哪一项在净资产变动表（Statement of Changes in Net Assets）中被记录为流出（outflow）而非流入（inflow）？

opts.t: Educational Assistance Payments (EAPs) paid to qualified students and government grants returned to the government.
opts.w: 正确。在净资产变动表（Statement of Changes in Net Assets）中，付给认购人与学生的钱（包含 EAP、退还的费用）以及退回政府的补助都属于资金流出（outflows）。

opts.t: Subscriber deposits received by the plan under each subscriber's contribution schedule during the fiscal year.
opts.w: 流向判断相反：认购人存入计划的供款存款（subscriber deposits）让计划净资产增加，属于净资产变动表中的流入（inflow）。

opts.t: Canada Education Savings Grants (CESG) and other government grants received by the plan during the year.
opts.w: 流向判断相反：计划收到的 CESG 及其他政府补助进入基金账户，属于流入（inflow）；只有把补助退回给政府时才算流出。

opts.t: Amounts transferred into the scholarship plan from another registered education savings plan during the year.
opts.w: 流向判断相反：从其他计划转入的资金（transfers from other plans）增加了本计划的资金池，属于流入（inflow）。

main.pt: 管理费区间与供款完成保险的保障对象
main.trap: 保险保障对象错位
main.stem: Which of the following statements correctly describes both the administration fee and completion insurance in a scholarship plan?
main.zh: 以下哪项陈述同时正确描述了奖学金计划中的管理费（administration fee）与供款完成保险（completion insurance）？

opts.t: The administration fee is a $50 annual fee paid directly to the dealing representative, and completion insurance pays out if the beneficiary drops out of university.
opts.w: 双重经典陷阱：从业代表（dealing representative）从不直接向客户收管理费；供款完成保险（completion insurance）保的是认购人身故或失能，不是「孩子没读完大学就赔钱」。

opts.t: The administration fee usually runs 0.5% to 1.5% of plan assets a year, and completion insurance finishes the scheduled contributions if the subscriber dies or is disabled.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径下，管理费（administration fee）用于计划与账户的一般管理及 EAP 流程管理，通常在计划资产的 0.5%–1.5%／年之间（集团计划约 0.5%／年，个人与家庭计划 0.5%–1.5%／年）；供款完成保险（completion insurance）是在认购人（subscriber）身故或失能时代其缴付剩余 RESP 供款的保险。

opts.t: The administration fee is capped at 0.10% to 0.33% per year for all plans, and completion insurance insures the life of the student beneficiary until graduation.
opts.w: 费率张冠李戴且保险对象错误：0.10%–0.33%／年是投资管理费（investment management fee）的区间；completion insurance 保的是出钱的认购人（subscriber），不是学生受益人（beneficiary）的性命。

opts.t: The administration fee is only charged when a cheque is returned NSF, and completion insurance premiums are non-refundable even if the plan is cancelled within 60 days.
opts.w: 费用性质与退保规则均错：NSF 退票费属于其他杂费（other charges）而非管理费；且在签约后 60 天内退出计划，已付的保险费（insurance premiums）也会全额退还。

main.pt: 按单位计价的销售费前置扣除节奏与计算
main.trap: 销售费平摊错觉
main.stem: Under the standard unit-based sales charge schedule used by most scholarship plan foundations, a subscriber contributes $200 per month toward units that carry a total sales charge of $1,600. After the first 8 months of contributions (totalling $1,600), how much of the sales charge has been paid and how much has been credited to the subscriber's principal?
main.zh: 按照多数奖学金计划基金会采用的按单位计价销售费标准收取节奏，一位认购人每月供款 $200，所购单位的总销售费为 $1,600。在前 8 个月供款（合计 $1,600）结束后，已付销售费与计入认购人本金的金额各是多少？

opts.t: $1,600 has been paid toward the sales charge and $0 has been credited to principal.
opts.w: 忽视「过半转 50%」规则：并非所有供款都 100% 扣到销售费全部付清为止——只有前一半销售费（$800）按供款的 100% 扣除，后一半销售费改按每笔供款的 50% 扣除。

opts.t: $800 has been paid toward the sales charge and $800 has been credited to principal, because 50% of every contribution goes to each from month one.
opts.w: 销售费平摊错觉：前一半销售费（$800，即前 4 个月）是从最初供款里 100% 全额扣除的，这 4 个月计入本金的是 $0，不是从第一个月起就对半平分。

opts.t: $400 has been paid toward the sales charge and $1,200 has been credited to principal, because sales charges are capped at 25% of contributions.
opts.w: 混淆退还阶梯与扣费节奏：25% 是满 15 年以上中途转入个人／家庭计划的销售费退还上限，不是每笔供款的销售费扣除比例。

opts.t: $1,200 has been paid toward the sales charge and $400 has been credited to principal, with 4 more months of 50% deductions remaining to finish paying the sales charge.
opts.w: 正确。按「先 100% 扣至付掉一半、后 50% 扣至全部付清」规则：总销售费（sales charge）为 $1,600，前一半是 $800。前 4 个月（4 × $200 = $800）100% 用于支付销售费，此时已付销售费 $800、本金 $0；第 5 至第 8 个月（共 4 个月）每月 $200 中有 50%（$100）付销售费、50%（$100）进本金，这 4 个月再付销售费 $400、进本金 $400。因此满 8 个月时累计已付销售费 $800 + $400 = $1,200，计入本金 $400，还剩 $400 销售费需再扣 4 个月。

main.pt: 60天内外退出的费用、补助额度与合规动作
main.trap: 销售费平摊错觉
main.stem: Compare two subscribers who cancel their group scholarship plans: Subscriber X cancels 40 days after signing, while Subscriber Y cancels 14 months after signing. Which statement accurately contrasts their outcomes?
main.zh: 对比两位取消集团奖学金计划的认购人：认购人 X 在签约后第 40 天取消，而认购人 Y 在签约后第 14 个月取消。以下哪项准确对比了两人的结果？

opts.t: X gets back everything paid, fees and premiums included; Y gets only net contributions, loses the investment income, and loses grant room tied to returned grants (other than CLB).
opts.w: 正确。签约后 60 天内（如第 40 天）退出，可无条件全额拿回所有已付款项（包括销售费与保险费）；60 天之后（如第 14 个月）取消，仅退回净供款（供款减去已付销售费与其他费用），投资收益全部损失（留给同组其他受益人），政府补助退回政府，且除 CLB 外的补助额度（Grant Contribution Room）也随之永久损失无法恢复。

opts.t: Both subscribers get back 100% of their contributions and the accumulated investment income, but Subscriber Y must also pay a 50% sales charge penalty.
opts.w: 收益与扣费概念错误：超过 60 天取消（Subscriber Y）拿不到任何投资收益，且少拿回钱是因为销售费已经在早期供款里先扣掉了，不是额外收 50% 违约金。

opts.t: Subscriber X forfeits half of the sales charge because the cancellation came after 30 days, while Subscriber Y keeps all of the CESG grants inside the plan.
opts.w: 窗口期与补助规则错误：全额无条件退费窗口是 60 天（不是 30 天），第 40 天退出一分钱不扣；且中途取消计划时，政府补助（如 CESG）必须退回政府，不能留在账户里。

opts.t: Subscriber X must wait until day 61 to request a withdrawal, while Subscriber Y automatically recovers 25% of sales charges upon cancellation.
opts.w: 违规拖延与退费条件错误：代表绝不能拖延客户到第 61 天；且 0–25% 的销售费退还只适用于转入个人／家庭计划并在日后提取 EAP 时按比例支付（且满 3 年才有 5%），直接取消一分钱销售费都不退。

main.pt: 销售费退还双路径与资格条件
main.trap: 销售费平摊错觉
main.stem: In a group scholarship plan that offers a refund of sales charges, how does the refund work when a subscriber stays in the group plan through maturity versus transferring to an individual or family plan?
main.zh: 某集团奖学金计划设有销售费退还（Refund of Sales Charges）：认购人留在集团计划直至到期，与中途转入个人或家庭计划相比，退还分别是如何运作的？

opts.t: Staying to maturity refunds 100% of sales charges plus investment income earned on those charges in a single lump sum at age 18.
opts.w: 比例、利息与支付方式三错：2007 年 10 月之后的新合同走完全程退还的是 50%（而非 100%，100% 仅限 2007 年 10 月之前的老合同），分四笔随 EAP 每次退 12.5%（而非一次性付），且明确不含销售费所产生的收益（does not include income earned on the sales charges）。

opts.t: Maturity with all four EAPs refunds 50% (12.5% per EAP); transferring to an individual or family plan refunds 0% to 25% by years in the group plan; the two cannot be combined.
opts.w: 正确。销售费退还（Refund of Sales Charges）有两条不可叠加的路径：路径一是留在集团计划交齐供款、到期且拿满四笔 EAP，共退还 50%（随四笔 EAP 每次退 12.5%，少拿一笔 EAP 就少一笔退还，且退还款免税、不含销售费收益）；路径二是中途转入个人／家庭计划，按在集团计划中的年限退还 0–25%（0–3 年为 0%，15 年以上最高 25%）。

opts.t: A subscriber who stays in the group plan for 16 years and then transfers to a family plan receives both the 50% maturity refund and the 25% transfer refund for a total of 75%.
opts.w: 叠加陷阱：全程留在集团计划拿 50% 与中途转入个人／家庭计划按年限拿 0–25% 是两条互斥的路径，绝不能叠加成 75%。

opts.t: If the beneficiary completes a two-year college diploma and collects two of the four EAPs in the group plan, the subscriber still receives the full 50% sales charge refund.
opts.w: EAP 挂钩规则错误：销售费退还笔数不能超过 EAP 笔数（每笔 EAP 退 12.5%）。如果孩子只读两年、四笔 EAP 只拿到两笔，则销售费退还也只能拿到两笔，即 25%（12.5% × 2），另外两笔永久失去。

main.pt: 区分KYC与适合性评估两项独立义务
main.trap: KYC与适合性概念偷换
main.stem: Which regulatory obligation specifically requires a dealing representative to recommend only those investment actions that match a client's needs, objectives, risk profile, and ability to afford ongoing contributions?
main.zh: 哪一项监管义务专门要求从业代表只推荐符合客户需求、目标、风险画像以及持续供款负担能力的投资行动？

opts.t: The Know Your Client (KYC) obligation, because gathering and verifying personal and financial facts automatically determines which plan is appropriate.
opts.w: 错误。这是「KYC与适合性概念偷换」陷阱。了解你的客户（Know Your Client, KYC）是收集与记录客户个人情况、财务情况、投资知识、风险画像和投资期限等事实，而用这些事实判断推荐是否合适属于另一项独立义务。

opts.t: The Fit and Proper standard, which evaluates whether the representative possesses the proficiency, integrity, and solvency needed to advise subscribers.
opts.w: 错误。适任标准（Fit and Proper）是监管机构与保荐经销商在注册阶段评估代表本人是否具备专业能力（Proficiency）、诚信（Integrity）和偿付能力（Solvency）的标准，而非针对客户交易的推荐评估义务。

opts.t: The Suitability Assessment obligation, which uses client facts, product knowledge, cost impact, and a reasonable range of options to judge whether an action is appropriate.
opts.w: 正确。适合性评估（Suitability Assessment）要求代表在合理基础上判定推荐给客户的每一项投资行动对他都合适，评估必须考虑客户 KYC、经销商了解你的产品（KYP）、投资成本影响、合理范围的投资选项以及奖学金计划的可负担性（Affordability）证据。

opts.t: The Relationship Disclosure obligation, which requires delivering a brochure at account opening that explains all fees, risks, and product restrictions.
opts.w: 错误。关系披露（Relationship Disclosure）是在关系之初向客户交付并解释关于其与经销商关系的重要信息（如自有产品限制、收费、争议解决等），属于信息披露义务而非推荐判断义务。

main.pt: KYC不可豁免与拒绝提供信息的处理
main.trap: 客户自愿豁免与人情诱因
main.stem: A prospective subscriber wants to open a scholarship plan but refuses to disclose her household income and net worth, offering instead to sign a written waiver releasing the dealer from liability. How must the dealing representative respond?
main.zh: 一位潜在认购人想开立奖学金计划，但拒绝披露家庭收入和净资产，并提出签署一份书面豁免书以免除经销商的责任。从业代表必须如何回应？

opts.t: Explain that KYC is a legal duty needed to advise her properly and that her information stays confidential, and decline to open the account if she still refuses.
opts.w: 正确。了解你的客户（KYC）是代表与经销商的法定义务，法律并未赋予客户放弃（Waive）这项义务的权利；代表须说明三点（法定义务、正确建议与确认供款资格的前提、证券法与隐私法下的保密义务），若客户仍拒绝，则不能为其开户。注：本题按考试口径作答；2025-12 发布的联合通报 31-368 进一步强化了 KYC 实务标准，但不改变此考试结论。

opts.t: Accept the signed waiver, attach it to the Enrolment Application Form, and submit the file to the local supervisor for special approval.
opts.w: 错误。这是「客户自愿豁免与人情诱因」陷阱。法律不赋予客户放弃 KYC 规则的权利，任何书面豁免书均无效，主管也不能批准缺失核心 KYC 与可负担性信息的开户申请。

opts.t: Open the account at a minimal contribution level for now and collect the missing financial details during the mandatory three-year KYC review.
opts.w: 错误。收集完整的五维度 KYC 信息并验证可负担性是开户推荐前的前提条件，不能先斩后奏等到每 3 年一次的定期复核时才补齐。

opts.t: Obtain the subscriber's financial details indirectly by contacting her designated Trusted Contact Person without requiring further input from the subscriber.
opts.w: 错误。可信联系人（Trusted Contact Person, TCP）仅用于在怀疑客户遭财务剥削或心智能力下降时保护客户利益，不得用来绕过客户本人收集常规开户财务信息。

main.pt: 重大利益冲突处理与佣金返还四禁令
main.trap: 客户自愿豁免与人情诱因
main.stem: A dealing representative notices that a prospective subscriber is hesitating because of the upfront sales charge. To help close the enrolment, the representative offers to rebate half of his sales commission directly to the subscriber after the 60-day withdrawal period. Which statement accurately describes this offer?
main.zh: 一位从业代表注意到潜在认购人因前期销售费而犹豫不决。为了促成签约，代表提出在 60 天退出期满后将自己一半的销售佣金直接返还给认购人。下列哪项陈述准确描述了这一提议？

opts.t: It is permissible as long as the rebate is documented in writing and disclosed to the local branch supervisor before the trade confirmation is issued.
opts.w: 错误。这是「客户自愿豁免与人情诱因」陷阱。销售费由经销商设定并载于招股书，经销商严禁代表提出返还部分佣金（Commission Rebate），向主管披露也无法使被禁止的诱因合法化。

opts.t: It is strictly prohibited because representatives are not authorized to negotiate lower sales charges, pay fees or deposits for clients, rebate commissions, or offer financial enticements to enrol.
opts.w: 正确。关于佣金返还与诱因有四条硬性禁令：代表不得协商降低销售费、不得代客户支付部分或全部销售费或存款、不得提出返还自己的部分佣金（Commission Rebate）、不得提供礼品或其他财务诱因（Enticements）以促成开户。

opts.t: It is allowed under the Conflict of Interest rules because reducing the subscriber's net cost places the client's financial interest ahead of the representative's own compensation.
opts.w: 错误。这是混淆利益冲突管理与违规诱因的陷阱。把客户利益放在第一位要求在同样合适时推荐费用更低的合规产品，而不是通过违规返佣或私下补贴来促成交易。

opts.t: It is acceptable provided the total value of the commission rebate is nominal and fits within the dealer's referral fee threshold.
opts.w: 错误。名义价值的感谢礼品或低于 $15 的推荐费是针对未注册推荐人（Referral Source）的合规披露安排，绝不适用于向客户本人返还佣金或提供开户诱因。

main.pt: 客户投诉处理时限与争议升级渠道
main.trap: DNCL与CASL时间窗口互换
main.stem: A subscriber residing in Ontario lodges a complaint alleging that her dealing representative misrepresented the conditions for early withdrawal. Under the complaint-handling rules for scholarship plan dealers, what are the timelines for the dealer's initial written response, the substantive response, and the subscriber's escalation to the Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments (OBSI)?
main.zh: 一位居住在安大略省的认购人提出投诉，指称其从业代表对提前退出的条件作了虚假陈述。根据奖学金计划经销商的投诉处理规则，经销商寄出书面初步回复、给出实质回复，以及认购人升级提交至银行服务与投资监察专员（OBSI）的时限分别是多少？

opts.t: Initial written response within 10 days, substantive response within 60 days, and escalation to OBSI within 90 days.
opts.w: 错误。这是数字混淆陷阱。10 天是注册申请表（Form 33-109F4）信息变更的报告期，60 天是招股书无成本退出期或 CASL 联系方式有效期，90 天是实质回复期而非提交 OBSI 的期限。

opts.t: Initial written response within 5 business days, substantive response within 180 days, and escalation to OBSI within 2 years.
opts.w: 错误。180 天是客户对结果不满意时提交银行服务与投资监察专员（OBSI）的时限（以及业绩数据距沟通日的最大间隔），而不是经销商给出实质回复的时限（应为 90 天）。

opts.t: Initial written response within 15 business days, substantive response within 90 days, and escalation to the Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF) within 180 days.
opts.w: 错误。书面初步回复时限为 5 个营业日而非 15 个营业日；此外，只有居住在魁北克省的客户才将第三方争议提交给金融市场管理局（AMF），安大略省居民适用 OBSI。

opts.t: Initial written response within 5 business days, substantive response within 90 days, and escalation to OBSI within 180 days if the subscriber remains dissatisfied.
opts.w: 正确。对于虚假陈述（Misrepresentation）等必须作出书面回复的六类投诉，标准时限为：5 个营业日内寄出书面初步回复（Initial Written Response），90 天内给出实质回复（Substantive Response），客户若不满意可在 180 天内提交银行服务与投资监察专员（OBSI）。

main.pt: 道德守则与跨会员转移计划的处理
main.trap: 集团计划跨机构转移的理由误判
main.stem: Why does the RESPDAC Code of Ethics state that dealing representatives must not encourage subscribers to transfer their scholarship plan business from one member to another, and what must happen if a subscriber initiates a transfer on their own?
main.zh: 为什么 RESPDAC《道德守则》规定从业代表不得鼓励认购人将其奖学金计划业务从一个会员转移到另一个会员？如果认购人自行决定转移，必须履行什么程序？

opts.t: The client may lose fees paid and earnings built up; if she still moves, the receiving side gets her written acknowledgment on the Plan Transfer Disclosure Form and gives a signed copy to the relinquishing member.
opts.w: 正确。不鼓励在集团计划之间转移业务的实体原因是客户可能因此损失已付费用与已累积收益，未必符合其最佳利益；当客户自行决定转移时，接收方须使用 RESPDAC 认可的《计划转移披露表》（Plan Transfer Disclosure Form）取得客户对财务影响的书面确认，将签署副本提供给转出方，并确保客户签约前充分理解影响与成本。

opts.t: Because transfers create excessive administrative paperwork between dealers; if the client insists, the relinquishing member must first approve the transfer before any of the forms are signed.
opts.w: 错误。这是「集团计划跨机构转移的理由误判」陷阱。不鼓励转移的核心理由是保护客户免受费用与累积收益损失，而非减少文书工作；且接收方只需将已签署的披露表副本提供给转出方，无需转出方事先审批同意。

opts.t: Because the Code of Ethics prohibits competition among members; if the client insists, the representative must refer the client to the securities commission for an independent review.
opts.w: 错误。这是「集团计划跨机构转移的理由误判」陷阱。《道德守则》（Code of Ethics）旨在倡导合规与公平竞争而非禁止竞争，客户自主转移无需送交证券监管机构审批。

opts.t: Because transferred plans lose their registration status with the Canada Revenue Agency; if the client insists, the representative need only obtain an oral confirmation during the meeting.
opts.w: 错误。守则给出的理由是客户可能损失已付费用与已累积收益，不是计划丧失注册资格；且接收方代表必须通过《计划转移披露表》（Plan Transfer Disclosure Form）取得客户的书面确认，仅凭口头确认不合规。

main.pt: 销售沟通标准与业绩数据180天时限
main.trap: 口头沟通不受广告规则约束
main.stem: Which of the following practices complies with the regulatory standards governing sales communications, advertisements, and the presentation of performance data for scholarship plans?
main.zh: 下列哪项做法符合管辖奖学金计划销售沟通、广告以及业绩数据展示的监管标准？

opts.t: Making an informal oral promise to a client during a home visit that unit values will match last year's return, since oral remarks are not treated as sales communications.
opts.w: 错误。这是「口头沟通不受广告规则约束」陷阱。销售沟通（Sales Communication）涵盖任何用以招揽或诱导购买奖学金计划的口头或书面沟通，严禁就单位未来价值或回报率作出任何承诺或保证。

opts.t: Publishing a pre-approved ad that names the dealer, says in 10-point or larger type that key information is in the prospectus, and shows 1-, 3-, 5- and 10-year returns ended within 180 days.
opts.w: 正确。广告与销售沟通须经经销商及合规官预批，须显著显示经销商名称并以至少 10 点（10-point）字号指明重要信息载于招股书且购买前应阅读；引用业绩数据时须说明一般假设、计算 1/3/5/10 年期间（不足 10 年另加自成立以来年化）、期末距沟通日不得超过 180 天，并声明过往业绩不必然预示未来表现。注：本题按考试口径作答；2025-12 发布的联合通报 31-369 针对社交媒体财经网红引流补充了监管指引，考试不考该通报编号。

opts.t: Distributing a performance flyer within 30 days of the fiscal year-end that quotes an internal credit rating prepared by the dealer's own marketing team.
opts.w: 错误。「只能在财年结束后 30 天内传播」是常见干扰项，真实规则是业绩期末距沟通日不超过 180 天；此外，不得引用业绩评级或排名（除非由第三方编制），亦不得引用所持证券的信用评级（除非当前有效且由认可评级机构编制）。

opts.t: Comparing the dealer's 5-year return against a competing scholarship plan's 3-year return without obtaining the competitor's permission to list its corporate name.
opts.w: 错误。业绩数据标准明确要求：与竞品比较必须使用相同时间段（Same Time Period）的数据并提供全部相同的比较信息，且必须事先取得对方公司许可才能在材料中列出其名称。

main.pt: DNCL电话规则与CASL反垃圾邮件法
main.trap: DNCL与CASL时间窗口互换
main.stem: How does the existing client exemption under the National Do Not Call List (National DNCL) telemarketing rules differ from implied consent for an existing business relationship under Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL)?
main.zh: 《全国拒接来电名单》（National DNCL）电话营销规则下的既有客户豁免，与《加拿大反垃圾邮件法》（CASL）下既有业务关系的默示同意有何不同？

opts.t: Under National DNCL rules, a representative may call a consumer on the list if they had business dealings within the past 2 years; under CASL, implied consent lasts for 18 months and permits soliciting any new product.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的「DNCL与CASL时间窗口互换」陷阱。把 National DNCL 的 18 个月与 CASL 的 2 年完全颠倒了，而且 CASL 下对现有客户的默示同意按考试口径仅限沟通既有产品或服务，不能用于招揽新产品。

opts.t: Under National DNCL rules, calling is permitted only between 10:00 and 18:00 on weekdays; under CASL, the maximum penalty for a violation is $10,000 for corporations.
opts.w: 错误。National DNCL 许可致电时段为周一至周五 9:00–21:30、周六与周日 10:00–18:00（按潜在客户当地时间）；CASL 罚则上限为个人最高 $1,000,000、企业最高 $10,000,000。

opts.t: DNCL lets you call a listed consumer you dealt with in the past 18 months; CASL implied consent from a purchase in the past 2 years covers existing products or services, not new solicitations.
opts.w: 正确。根据电话营销规则，哪怕号码名列《全国拒接来电名单》（National DNCL），若是过去 18 个月内有过业务往来的消费者（现有客户），仍可致电；而根据《加拿大反垃圾邮件法》（CASL），既有业务关系的默示同意（Implied Consent）要求客户在发出商业电子讯息（CEM）前 2 年内购买过产品或服务，且考试口径强调前提是你沟通的是既有产品或服务，而不是在招揽新的产品或服务。

opts.t: Under both National DNCL and CASL, representatives must immediately send a confirmation email to the client after processing an opt-out or do-not-call request.
opts.w: 错误。考试口径在 CASL 规则中明文规定：每封商业电子讯息都要有退订方法，必须立即执行每一项退订请求（请求一经发出即时生效），且不得再发一封邮件确认退订已处理。

main.pt: CSA与NI的法律性质
main.trap: 把协调协会或自律组织当成直管机关
main.stem: Marcus is preparing for his registration exam and reads that his dealing representative proficiency requirement is set out in National Instrument 31-103, developed through the Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA). Which statement accurately describes the legal status of the CSA and National Instruments?
main.zh: Marcus 正在备考注册考试，读到他的交易代表准入考试要求写在由加拿大证券管理局（CSA）制定的《全国性文件 31-103》（NI 31-103）中。下列哪项准确描述了 CSA 与全国性文件（NI）的法律地位？

opts.t: The CSA is an informal association of the 13 provincial and territorial regulators with no enforcement power, and an NI is a rule each local regulator adopts in the same form.
opts.w: 正确。加拿大证券管理局（Canadian Securities Administrators, CSA）是 13 家省和地区证监会的非正式全国性协会（informal national association），没有独立执法权；全国性文件（National Instrument, NI）是由各省和地区监管机构各自在本辖区以统一方式采纳的省级规则。

opts.t: The CSA is a federal crown corporation established by Parliament, and a National Instrument is a federal statute that overrides provincial securities laws.
opts.w: 错误。落入「把协调协会当成联邦机关」陷阱：证券监管属省级管辖权，加拿大没有联邦证监会或联邦证券法，CSA 不是联邦皇冠公司，NI 也不是联邦法律。

opts.t: The CSA is a self-regulatory organization that directly registers scholarship plan dealing representatives, and a National Instrument is a non-binding guideline.
opts.w: 错误。CSA 不是自律监管组织（Self-Regulatory Organization, SRO），也不能直接给个人注册；此外 NI 是有法律约束力的规则，解释性与预期性的文件叫做全国政策（National Policy, NP）。

opts.t: The CSA is a division of the federal tax authority, and a National Instrument only applies in provinces that have signed a multilateral exemption agreement.
opts.w: 错误。CSA 与联邦税务局（CRA）毫无隶属关系；只在部分而非全部辖区适用的文件叫做多边文件（Multilateral Instrument, MI），而 NI 覆盖全部辖区。

main.pt: 交易定义与抢跑禁令
main.trap: 误以为只有正式签单收款才算证券法下的交易
main.stem: Elena has passed her proficiency exam and her dealer's Authorized Firm Representative submitted her Form 33-109F4 through the National Registration Database yesterday. While waiting for confirmation, Elena meets young parents at a community centre to explain plan features and persuade them to enrol next week. How does securities legislation treat Elena's conduct?
main.zh: Elena 已经通过准入考试，其经销商的授权公司代表昨天已通过全国注册数据库（NRD）提交了她的 33-109F4 申请表。在等待确认期间，Elena 在社区中心约见年轻父母，讲解计划特点并劝说他们下周签约。证券法规如何定性 Elena 的行为？

opts.t: It is permissible educational outreach because no subscription contract was signed and no money changed hands between Elena and the parents during the meeting.
opts.w: 错误。日常语言里的「还没签单就不算交易」在证券法下不成立；证券法对交易（trading）的定义极宽，任何为促成交易而作的招揽或磋商都已构成 trading。

opts.t: It is unregistered trading: soliciting or negotiating toward a sale already counts as trading, and her registration is not in effect until approved and confirmed by the dealer.
opts.w: 正确。证券法下的交易（trading）包含卖出证券、接受指令以及任何为促成交易而作的行为、招揽或磋商（any act, solicitation or negotiation in furtherance of a trade）；提交申请不等于获批，必须等监管机构批准且经销商通知确认后方可开展业务，提前抢跑属于可被起诉的无牌交易。

opts.t: It is allowed under a temporary 10-day grace period that begins as soon as Form 33-109F4 is uploaded to the National Registration Database.
opts.w: 错误。NRD 提交 33-109F4 没有任何所谓的 10 天临时展业宽限期；10 天是注册后信息变更（33-109F5）和离职通知（33-109F1）的报备时限。

opts.t: It is a minor internal compliance breach that only requires Elena to file a Form 33-109F5 update within 30 days.
opts.w: 错误。未获批注册即开展招揽属于违反证券法的无牌交易（unregistered trading），是可被刑事起诉或严厉行政执法的违法行为，绝非补填一张信息变更表就能解决的轻微内部违规。

main.pt: 跨省注册与10天报备
main.trap: 以办公地代替客户居住地判断注册辖区
main.stem: David is registered as a scholarship plan dealing representative solely in Ontario. This month, he moved to a new residential apartment in Toronto, started working weekend shifts as a paid real estate photography contractor, and received a call from his cousin living in British Columbia who wants David to open a scholarship plan for her newborn. What must David do to remain compliant?
main.zh: David 仅在安大略省注册为奖学金计划交易代表。本月，他在多伦多搬进了新公寓，开始在周末兼职做有偿房产摄影承包商，并接到住在卑诗省的表姐来电，请 David 为她的新生儿开立一份奖学金计划。David 必须怎么做才能保持合规？

opts.t: He may enrol his cousin because the call was received at his Ontario office, and he has 30 days to report his new residential address and weekend job.
opts.w: 错误。同时踩中两个陷阱：第一，注册辖区看客户居住地（卑诗省）而非代表接电话的办公地（安省）；第二，住址变更和新增外部业务活动（outside business activity）都属于 10 天报备事项，30 天仅适用于国籍变更或过往受雇经历。

opts.t: He may enrol his cousin under a family-member registration exemption as long as he waives his commission, and he only needs to report his weekend job at year-end renewal.
opts.w: 错误。证券法下的注册豁免非常有限，一般不适用于奖学金计划交易代表（SPD dealing representative），帮亲属或不收佣金均不能免除在客户居住省的注册义务；且外部业务无论有无报酬都须在 10 天内报备。

opts.t: He must register in B.C. or refer his cousin to a rep registered there, and must report his new address and outside activity on Form 33-109F5 within 10 days.
opts.w: 正确。交易代表必须在客户居住的每一个省或地区注册，未在卑诗省注册就必须先获批卑诗省注册或转介给持卑诗省牌照的同事；同时依 NI 33-109，住址变更与新增外部受雇或业务活动（无论有无报酬）均须在 10 天内通过 NRD 用 33-109F5 报备。

opts.t: He must file Form 33-109F1 within 10 days to report his new apartment, and his Ontario registration automatically grants a 60-day mobility pass to sell in British Columbia.
opts.w: 错误。33-109F1 是离职终止通知而非信息变更表（信息变更用 F5），且奖学金计划交易代表不存在所谓的 60 天跨省免注册通行证。

main.pt: SPD直管与CIRO边界
main.trap: 把协调协会或自律组织当成直管机关
main.stem: A new dealing representative at a scholarship plan dealer reads that IIROC and the MFDA combined on January 1, 2023, creating the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO). How does this affect a firm registered only as a scholarship plan dealer and its representatives?
main.zh: 一家奖学金计划经销商新入职的交易代表在网上读到，IIROC 与 MFDA 已于 2023 年 1 月 1 日合并成立加拿大投资监管组织（CIRO）。这一合并对仅注册为奖学金计划经销商的公司及其代表的监管有何影响？

opts.t: All scholarship plan dealers automatically became CIRO Dealer Members on January 1, 2023, and must follow CIRO's continuing education rules.
opts.w: 错误。落入二手资料最常见的误区：CIRO 只合并了原 IIROC（管投资交易商）与 MFDA（管共同基金交易商），奖学金计划经销商（SPD）并未加入 CIRO，CIRO 的持续教育（CE）规则也不适用于 SPD。

opts.t: CIRO handles initial registration approvals for scholarship plan dealing representatives, while provincial commissions retain only enforcement powers.
opts.w: 错误。各省证监会委托给 CIRO 的注册职能仅覆盖投资交易商与共同基金交易商，SPD 的公司与个人注册审批依然由各省和地区证监会直接负责。

opts.t: Scholarship plan dealers are regulated by the Canadian Investor Protection Fund (CIPF), which absorbed the oversight functions of both IIROC and MFDA.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大投资者保护基金（CIPF）是独立于 CIRO 的投资者保护基金，既不是监管机构，也不管辖仅注册为 SPD 的经销商。

opts.t: They are not CIRO members; the firm and its representatives stay registered with, and directly regulated by, the provincial and territorial securities commissions.
opts.w: 正确。CIRO 仅监管投资交易商（investment dealers）和共同基金交易商（mutual fund dealers）；仅注册为奖学金计划经销商（Scholarship Plan Dealer, SPD）的公司及其交易代表不在 CIRO 范围内，仍由所属省或地区证监会直接注册、直接检查和直接处罚。

main.pt: 招股书收据与60天撤回权
main.trap: 把招股书收据当成政府认可或批准投资价值
main.stem: Sophia signed a scholarship plan application on May 1, but her dealing representative forgot to provide the current Plan Summary and Plan Prospectus until May 20, when Sophia received them in person. Under National Policy 15 and provincial securities legislation, what does the regulator's receipt for the prospectus signify, and when does Sophia's statutory withdrawal period expire?
main.zh: Sophia 于 5 月 1 日签署了一份奖学金计划申请，但她的交易代表忘了提供现行有效的《计划摘要》和《计划招股书》，直到 5 月 20 日 Sophia 才当面收到。根据《全国政策第 15 号》（NP 15）及省级证券法，监管机构对该招股书出具的收据意味着什么？Sophia 的法定撤回期何时届满？

opts.t: The receipt shows only that the documents meet legal form and content standards, not that the plan has investment merit, and Sophia's 60 days run from May 20, when she got the prospectus.
opts.w: 正确。监管机构出具招股书收据（receipt）仅表示披露文件在形式与内容上达到了完整、真实、清楚披露（full, true and plain disclosure）的法定要求，绝不代表认可其投资价值；同时撤回权时钟从购买人收到招股书之日（5 月 20 日）起算，NP 15 将奖学金计划的撤回期从 2 个营业日延长至 60 天。

opts.t: The receipt confirms that the securities commission guarantees the plan's investment safety, and Sophia's 60-day withdrawal period runs from May 1 when she signed the contract.
opts.w: 错误。同时踩中两个核心陷阱：第一，证监会从不为任何证券的投资价值或安全性背书；第二，撤回期从收到招股书起算而非从签约日起算，未收到招股书前客户享有持续的取消权（ongoing right to cancel）。

opts.t: The receipt means the plan is exempt from continuous distribution rules, and Sophia has only 2 business days from May 20 to cancel without penalty.
opts.w: 错误。2 个营业日是一般证券的撤回权期限，而全国政策第 15 号（NP 15）专门将奖学金计划的撤回权延长到了收到招股书后 60 天。

opts.t: The receipt validates the dealer's sales projections, and because the dealer missed the midnight second-business-day delivery deadline, Sophia must wait 180 days before requesting a refund.
opts.w: 错误。经销商延迟交付招股书绝不会剥夺或推迟客户的撤回权，恰恰相反，在收到招股书之前客户的取消权一直挂着不灭；180 天是法定撤销之诉（rescission）的诉讼时效。

main.pt: 证监会执法权的边界
main.trap: 误以为证监会能直接判令赔偿或强迫客户履约
main.stem: Following an investigation into a scholarship plan dealer's branch office, a provincial securities commission finds evidence of deceptive sales practices. Which of the following actions is generally BEYOND the direct statutory powers of the securities commission?
main.zh: 在对一家奖学金计划经销商的分支机构进行调查后，省级证监会发现了欺骗性销售行为的证据。下列哪项行动通常超出了证监会的直接法定权力范围？

opts.t: Suspending or revoking the dealing representative's registration and issuing a cease-trade order after providing an opportunity for a hearing.
opts.w: 错误。暂停或撤销注册（suspending or revoking registration）以及发出停止交易令（cease-trade order）是证监会最核心的行政处分工具，属于其法定职权。

opts.t: Ordering the dealer to pay direct restitution to compensate the affected subscribers, or ordering a subscriber to honour the terms of their subscription agreement.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径明确指出两项证监会「没有」的权力：第一，监管机构通常没有权力命令向投资者补偿或返还（generally do not have the power to order compensation or restitution to investors），投资者拿钱须走法院民事诉讼；第二，监管机构管的是市场参与者，无权命令投资者履行其认购协议条款（order an investor to honour the terms of their subscription agreement）。

opts.t: Entering the business premises of the registrant to conduct a compliance examination and compelling witnesses to produce records.
opts.w: 错误。进入营业场所检查、强制注册人及证人提供记录和作证，属于证监会的法定调查权（investigation powers）。

opts.t: Prohibiting a culpable individual from acting as a director or officer of any securities issuer and imposing an administrative financial penalty.
opts.w: 错误。发出董事或高管禁任令（prohibition from acting as a director or officer）以及处以行政罚款（部分辖区可达 100 万加元或以上）均属于证监会的法定行政处分权力。

main.pt: 双重身份核实与营销时限
main.trap: 只记反洗钱豁免而漏掉证券法强制身份核实
main.stem: Liam is opening a Registered Education Savings Plan (RESP) for a new client and also reviewing his list of past clients to send commercial electronic messages (emails) and make telemarketing calls to individuals registered on the National Do Not Call List (DNCL). Which combination of rules regarding client identity verification and existing-client marketing windows is accurate?
main.zh: Liam 正在为一位新客户开立注册教育储蓄计划（RESP），同时梳理老客户名单，准备发送商业电子信息（电邮）并向已登记在全国谢绝来电名单（National DNCL）上的客户拨打营销电话。关于客户身份核实以及既有客户营销豁免期，下列哪项规则组合是准确的？

opts.t: He does not need to verify the new client's identity because RESPs are exempt under federal anti-money laundering laws; implied consent for emails lasts 18 months, and the DNCL telemarketing exemption lasts 2 years.
opts.w: 错误。同时掉进两个经典陷阱：第一，虽然反洗钱法豁免注册计划账户的身份核实，但证券法 NI 31-103 s.13.2 仍强制要求核实每位客户身份；第二，把 CASL 的 2 年和 DNCL 的 18 个月完全记反了。

opts.t: He must verify the new client's identity only because federal anti-money laundering law (PCMLTFA) requires it; both email implied consent and the DNCL telemarketing exemption expire after 12 months.
opts.w: 错误。核实 RESP 客户身份的强制依据是证券法（NI 31-103 s.13.2）而非反洗钱法（PCMLTFA 对注册计划有豁免），且两个营销豁免期分别是 2 年和 18 个月，不是 12 个月。

opts.t: AML law exempts registered plan accounts, but NI 31-103 s.13.2 still requires reasonable steps to confirm every client's identity; CASL implied consent from a purchase lasts 2 years and the DNCL exemption 18 months.
opts.w: 正确。完美避开两个高频陷阱：① 身份核实的双层结构——《犯罪所得（洗钱）及恐怖主义融资法》（PCMLTFA）虽豁免注册计划账户，但证券法 NI 31-103 s.13.2 强制要求注册人采取合理步骤确认每位客户身份；② 两个既存关系时长不同——加拿大反垃圾邮件立法（CASL）下基于购买行为的默示同意（implied consent）为 2 年内，而加拿大广播电视和电信委员会（CRTC）全国谢绝来电名单（National DNCL）的既有业务往来豁免为 18 个月内。

opts.t: He only needs to verify identity if the client contributes $10,000 or more in cash; CASL allows unlimited emails without an unsubscribe link to past clients, and telemarketing calls are permitted until 23:00 on Sundays.
opts.w: 错误。NI 31-103 s.13.2 的身份核实要求适用于每一位客户，不设 $10,000 门槛；CASL 要求每一封商业电子信息（CEM）都必须包含免费、醒目且立即生效的退订机制；电话营销周末允许时段为 10:00–18:00（周一至周五为 9:00–21:30），周日晚上 23:00 严禁拨打。

main.pt: GDP核算包含与排除项及衰退定义
main.trap: GDP重复计算与转移支付陷阱
main.stem: Statistics Canada is compiling the national Gross Domestic Product (GDP) figures for the period. Which of the following items is included in the calculation of Canada's GDP?
main.zh: 加拿大统计局（Statistics Canada）正在编制该时期的全国国内生产总值（GDP）数据。下列哪一项包含在加拿大 GDP 的计算中？

opts.t: Government transfer payments such as employment insurance benefits and old age pensions.
opts.w: 错误。属于「GDP重复计算与转移支付陷阱」：国内生产总值（Gross Domestic Product, GDP）明确不包含养老金、失业保险和福利金等政府转移支付（transfer payments）。

opts.t: The cost of raw materials purchased by a manufacturer to produce finished goods.
opts.w: 错误。属于「GDP重复计算与转移支付陷阱」：为避免重复计算（double counting），企业为生产最终产品而购买的原材料与服务不包含在 GDP 内。

opts.t: Capital spending by a business to construct a new factory building in Canada.
opts.w: 正确。国内生产总值（Gross Domestic Product, GDP）衡量给定时期内生产的商品与服务总价值，包含个人消费、政府支出、企业投资（包括企业投入新工厂建筑的资金）以及净出口。

opts.t: The estimated market value of unpaid household work and homemaker productivity.
opts.w: 错误。属于「GDP重复计算与转移支付陷阱」：考试口径专门指出「GDP 衡量家庭主妇的生产力（homemaker productivity）」是常见错误选项，GDP 不衡量未经过市场交易的家务劳动。

main.pt: 财政政策与货币政策的工具及时滞
main.trap: 财政与货币政策串位陷阱
main.stem: How does monetary policy differ from fiscal policy in managing the Canadian economy?
main.zh: 在管理加拿大经济方面，货币政策与财政政策有何不同？

opts.t: Monetary policy is conducted by the Bank of Canada through short-term interest rates and typically takes 18 to 24 months to take full effect.
opts.w: 正确。货币政策（Monetary Policy）由加拿大央行（Bank of Canada）执行，主要通过影响短期利率来调节流通中的货币量；其时滞通常为 18 到 24 个月，因此央行必须采取前瞻性行动。

opts.t: Monetary policy is conducted by the federal government through taxation and infrastructure spending with an immediate, predictable effect.
opts.w: 错误。属于「财政与货币政策串位陷阱」：税收与基建支出属于政府的财政政策（Fiscal Policy），且财政政策的时滞既不即时也不确定。

opts.t: Monetary policy requires the Bank of Canada to set the actual monthly Consumer Price Index rate between 4% and 7%.
opts.w: 错误。属于「财政与货币政策串位陷阱」：央行设定的是 1% 到 3% 的通胀控制目标区间（而非每月直接设定 CPI 数值，4 到 7 年则是经济周期的长度）。

opts.t: Monetary policy pulls money out of the economy by raising personal income tax rates when capacity utilization is low.
opts.w: 错误。属于「财政与货币政策串位陷阱」：加税（raising tax rates）从经济中抽走资金是政府财政政策的工具，不是加拿大央行的货币政策工具。

main.pt: 利率变动与债券市值的反向关系
main.trap: 通胀与利率方向反推陷阱
main.stem: An investor holds a long-term bond with a face value of $1,000 and a fixed coupon rate of 7% that pays $70 per year. If market interest rates rise significantly, what happens to the bond's market value and why?
main.zh: 一位投资者持有一张面值 $1,000、固定票面利率 7%（每年支付 $70）的长期债券。如果市场利率大幅上升，该债券的市值会发生什么变化？为什么？

opts.t: Its market value rises because the bond's issuer must increase the annual coupon payment above $70 to match market rates.
opts.w: 错误。债券的票面利率（coupon rate）和每年 $70 的利息支付是固定的，发行人不会因为市场利率上升而调高已发行债券的票息。

opts.t: Its value falls, because its fixed $70 is less attractive than coupons on new higher-rate bonds, so it must sell below face value to compete.
opts.w: 正确。根据利率风险（Interest Rate Risk）与收益率（Yield）机制，利率上升时已发行固定收益证券的价值下降（对长期债券影响尤大）：因为票息固定为 $70，旧债只能靠降低交易价格（如低于 $1,000 面值）才能让新买家的实际收益率提升到当前市场水平。

opts.t: Its market value remains at $1,000 at all times because bonds are traded on public stock exchanges with guaranteed price stability.
opts.w: 错误。债券一般不在股票交易所交易，而是走场外债券市场（over-the-counter bond market），且到期前的市值会随市场利率波动。

opts.t: Its market value rises because higher interest rates strengthen the domestic currency and reduce inflation risk.
opts.w: 错误。属于「通胀与利率方向反推陷阱」：利率上升必然导致已发行固定利率债券的市值下跌，而不是上升。

main.pt: 奖学金计划特有的负担能力风险与风险承受力
main.trap: 绝对化措辞与低风险保本错觉陷阱
main.stem: Securities regulators require scholarship plan dealers to address a specific risk in both the relationship disclosure document and the Plan Summary before a client makes a decision. What is this risk, and what is the representative's duty?
main.zh: 证券监管机构要求奖学金计划交易商在客户作出决定之前，必须在「关系披露」文件和计划摘要（Plan Summary）中处理一项特定风险。这项风险是什么？代表的义务是什么？

opts.t: Currency risk; the representative must hedge foreign exchange fluctuations for the subscriber's contributions.
opts.w: 错误。汇率风险（Currency risk）是外币投资折回本币的价值变动，并非奖学金计划特有的核心监管披露焦点。

opts.t: Market risk; the representative must guarantee that the scholarship plan's pooled investments will never experience a loss.
opts.w: 错误。属于「绝对化措辞与低风险保本错觉陷阱」：没有任何人保证奖学金计划的回报或为投资损失提供保险。

opts.t: Political risk; the representative must predict future statutory changes to tax credits over the next 18 to 24 months.
opts.w: 错误。政治风险（Political risk）与 18–24 个月货币政策时滞被错误拼接，与奖学金计划强制披露的提前取消风险无关。

opts.t: Affordability risk; explain what early cancellation costs and the prospectus options for avoiding a forced cancellation.
opts.w: 正确。负担能力风险（Affordability Risk）是奖学金计划特有的重大风险，即认购人因无力维持供款而被迫在到期前取消计划并蒙受损失（60 天冷静期后不退入会费）；代表必须在客户决定前讲清提前取消的后果及招股书中可缓解被迫取消的选项。

main.pt: 风险谱系与各类金融工具的特征对比
main.trap: 绝对化措辞与低风险保本错觉陷阱
main.stem: Which of the following accurately describes a Treasury bill (T-bill) and its position on the investment risk spectrum?
main.zh: 下列哪项准确描述了国库券（T-bill）及其在投资风险谱系上的位置？

opts.t: A government debt security maturing in under a year; very low risk; pays no interest and is sold below its maturity value.
opts.w: 正确。国库券（Treasury Bill, T-bill）由联邦及部分省发行，属于到期日短于一年的现金等价物，风险档位为极低（very low）；它不付利息，而是以低于到期面值的价格折价出售，不可赎回但通常可通过投资交易商快速卖出。

opts.t: It is a short-term deposit certificate insured by CDIC that pays a high fixed monthly interest rate.
opts.w: 错误。属于「绝对化措辞与低风险保本错觉陷阱」：考试常设陷阱「T-bill 付高利息」，实际上 T-bill 不付利息；由 CDIC 承保的存款凭证是 GIC。

opts.t: It is an insurance contract that guarantees 75% to 100% of the original investment at maturity.
opts.w: 错误。保险合同形态、通常保证原始投资 75%–100% 的集合投资产品是分红基金（Segregated Fund），而非国库券。

opts.t: It carries higher risk than common shares and futures contracts because it cannot be redeemed before maturity.
opts.w: 错误。国库券风险极低，而普通股（中等到极高风险）与期货合约（衍生品，风险在谱系表之上）的风险远高于国库券。

main.pt: 奖学金计划单位的风险档位与三大回报变量
main.trap: 绝对化措辞与低风险保本错觉陷阱
main.stem: How are scholarship plan units classified on the investment risk spectrum, and what determines the return an investor actually receives?
main.zh: 奖学金计划单位在投资风险谱系上如何分类？是什么决定了投资者实际获得的回报？

opts.t: Very low risk; returns are guaranteed by the trustee regardless of whether the beneficiary attends post-secondary education.
opts.w: 错误。属于「绝对化措辞与低风险保本错觉陷阱」：奖学金计划的风险档位是可变（Variable）而非极低，没有人保证回报；若受益人不就读合资格课程，投资者可能拿不到任何投资回报（收益通常分配给升学的其他参与者）。

opts.t: Low to very high risk; units can be redeemed at any time at Net Asset Value Per Share (NAVPS) with full refund of sales charges after 60 days.
opts.w: 错误。低到极高风险、按每单位资产净值（NAVPS）随时赎回且有表决权的是共同基金（Mutual Fund）；奖学金计划在 60 天冷静期之后取消不退还入会费。

opts.t: Variable risk; capital-loss risk is low, but returns depend on portfolio yield, whether the beneficiary studies, and whether contributions are kept up.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径将奖学金计划单位（Scholarship Plan Units）的风险列为可变（Variable）：虽然主要投向安全生息工具使得资本损失风险低，但能否拿到回报取决于三个变量——投资组合收益率、受益人是否就读合资格课程、以及认购人能否履行供款承诺。

opts.t: Moderate to high risk; holders receive fixed dividends ahead of common shareholders upon corporate liquidation.
opts.w: 错误。先于普通股取得固定股息、清盘时排在债权人之后与普通股之前的是优先股（Preferred Shares），不是奖学金计划单位。

main.pt: 三种投资收入的税负排序与资本损失冲抵规则
main.trap: 资本损失乱冲抵与竞品贬低陷阱
main.stem: An investor earns equal dollar amounts of interest income, eligible dividends from Canadian corporations, and capital gains outside a registered plan, and also realizes a capital loss on another stock. Which tax rule applies?
main.zh: 一位投资者在非注册账户中获得了同等金额的利息收入、加拿大公司合资格股息和资本利得，同时在另一只股票上产生了资本损失。适用哪项税务规则？

opts.t: Interest income enjoys the lightest tax burden due to the interest tax credit, and capital losses can offset employment income.
opts.w: 错误。属于「资本损失乱冲抵与竞品贬低陷阱」：利息没有税收抵免，按普通收入全额课税，税后到手金额最少；且资本损失不能冲抵受雇工资收入。

opts.t: Interest is taxed like employment income and leaves the least after tax, and capital losses may be applied only against capital gains.
opts.w: 正确。利息（Interest）作为普通收入课税，税率与受雇收入相同，同样一笔收益以利息形式拿到的税后金额最少；加拿大公司股息（Dividends）因股息税收抵免（Dividend Tax Credit）税负更轻；资本利得（Capital Gains）部分免税，而资本损失（Capital Losses）只能用来冲抵资本利得。

opts.t: Canadian dividends are completely exempt from tax at all times, and capital losses can be deducted against interest income.
opts.w: 错误。加拿大公司股息享受股息税收抵免因而税负比利息轻，但并非完全免税；资本损失也不能冲抵利息收入。

opts.t: Capital gains are taxed more heavily than interest income, and capital losses expire unless transferred into an RRSP.
opts.w: 错误。资本利得通常可部分从应税收入中排除，税负比按普通收入全额课税的利息更轻。

main.pt: 基金会与分销子公司职责及佣金来源
main.trap: 佣金来源混淆陷阱
main.stem: A prospective subscriber reviewing the plan disclosure document asks how the non-profit foundation and its wholly owned for-profit distributor subsidiary divide their roles, and whether the annual management fees deducted from the plan are used to pay the dealing representative's commission. Which explanation is accurate?
main.zh: 一位潜在认购人在审阅计划披露文件时询问：非营利基金会与其全资营利分销子公司如何划分职责？从计划中扣除的年度管理费是否用于支付销售代表的佣金？下列哪项解释是准确的？

opts.t: The non-profit foundation signs the contract and collects the administration and account maintenance fees; representative commissions come only from subscriber sales charges, not plan management fees.
opts.w: 正确。非营利基金会作为计划发起人（Plan Sponsor）与认购人签订协议并收取综合管理费与账户管理费；全资营利子公司作为主分销商（Principal Distributor）所得分销报酬直接来自认购人支付的销售费（Sales Charges），销售代表佣金绝不来源于计划的管理费。

opts.t: The for-profit subsidiary is the legal counterparty to the subscriber's contract and funds representative commissions by taking a fixed percentage of the plan's annual administration fees.
opts.w: 错误。与认购人签订教育储蓄计划协议（Education Savings Plan Agreement）的合同对手方是非营利基金会而非营利子公司，且代表佣金不从管理费中提取，属于佣金来源混淆陷阱。

opts.t: Both the non-profit foundation and the for-profit scholarship plan dealer are regulated as Dealer Members of the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO), which sets their commission split.
opts.w: 错误。专营奖学金计划的分销子公司注册为奖学金计划交易商（Scholarship Plan Dealer, SPD），由各省证监会直管，不加入加拿大投资监管组织（CIRO），仅销售共同基金的姊妹公司才是 CIRO 会员，属于监管归属混淆陷阱。

opts.t: The independent trustee and custodian collects the $200 per-unit sales charge and distributes half of it to the dealing representative and half to the six portfolio managers.
opts.w: 错误。$200/单位的销售费（Sales Charge）用于划入销售费退还隔离准备金及支付主分销商的分销费，并非由受托人平分给销售代表和组合经理（组合经理费用由基金会从综合管理费中支付），属于资金流向张冠李戴陷阱。

main.pt: 集团计划单位与两类脱落机制
main.trap: 两类脱落去向颠倒陷阱
main.stem: In a group scholarship plan, Subscriber Lin cancels her plan six years before the maturity date and withdraws her net contributions, while Subscriber Okafor keeps his plan to maturity, but his beneficiary decides never to enrol in any post-secondary education program. How are the investment earnings on their contributions treated under the two types of attrition?
main.zh: 在集团奖学金计划中，认购人 Lin 在到期日前 6 年取消计划并提取其净供款；而认购人 Okafor 将计划保持至到期，但其受益人决定不再入读任何高等教育课程。在两类脱落机制下，他们供款所产生的投资收益分别如何处理？

opts.t: Lin's cancellation triggers post-maturity attrition where earnings are returned to the foundation's general operating account, whereas Okafor's case triggers pre-maturity attrition and allows an Accumulated Income Payment (AIP).
opts.w: 错误。到期前取消属于到期前脱落（Pre-maturity Attrition），到期后不读书属于到期后脱落（Post-maturity Attrition），且集团计划不支持累计收益提取（Accumulated Income Payment, AIP），属于两类脱落去向颠倒陷阱。

opts.t: Lin's cancellation is pre-maturity attrition and Okafor's case is post-maturity attrition; in both, the forfeited earnings stay in the beneficiary group's EAP account for the remaining beneficiaries.
opts.w: 正确。认购人在到期前取消计划或转出触发到期前脱落（Pre-maturity Attrition），受益人在到期后不入读合资格课程或未在受益期内领满全部 EAP 触发到期后脱落（Post-maturity Attrition）；被没收的收益不会退还给原认购人，而是留在并转入该受益人组（Beneficiary Group）的 EAP 账户中由留存达标受益人分享。

opts.t: Both Lin and Okafor receive 100% of their accumulated investment earnings in cash as long as they forfeit 50% of their initial sales charges to the beneficiary group.
opts.w: 错误。集团奖学金计划（Group Scholarship Plan）中一旦取消或受益人不入读合资格课程（且未在时限内转入自主型计划），供款产生的收益即被没收留存组内，不能以放弃一半销售费换取现金提走，属于收益退还误导陷阱。

opts.t: Lin's forfeited earnings are transferred to the government grant pool, whereas Okafor's forfeited earnings are paid to the dealing representative as a group plan bonus.
opts.w: 错误。个人供款所生收益被没收后进入该受益人组的 EAP 账户供同组受益人分享，既不交给政府补助池，也绝不会发给销售代表（集团计划奖金 Group Plan Bonus 是从普通基金支付以补充受益人 EAP 的款项），属于术语张冠李戴陷阱。

main.pt: 三类在售计划门槛与独有费用
main.trap: 计划费用张冠李戴陷阱
main.stem: A client wants to compare the fee structures and eligibility rules of the dealer's three active plans: the group scholarship plan, the individual self-determined plan, and the family self-determined plan. Which statement is correct?
main.zh: 一位客户希望比较该交易商三个在售计划（集团奖学金计划、个人自主型计划与家庭自主型计划）的费用结构与受益人资格规则。下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: All three plans charge an annual Account Maintenance Fee, but only the family self-determined plan charges a $200 per-unit sales charge.
opts.w: 错误。个人和家庭自主型计划没有单位（Unit），销售费为 $50/计划，且不收账户管理费（Account Maintenance Fee），属于计划费用张冠李戴陷阱。

opts.t: The individual self-determined plan requires the beneficiary to be under age 13 and related to the subscriber by blood or adoption, with a minimum monthly contribution of $9.50.
opts.w: 错误。入组未满 13 岁、最低月供 $9.50 或 1/10 单位是集团计划的要求；个人自主型计划（Individual Savings Plan）最低认购为 $150，且受益人不必与认购人有亲属关系，属于三计划资格条件混同陷阱。

opts.t: Only the group plan charges the Account Maintenance Fee (plus $200 per unit, beneficiaries under 13 at entry); both self-determined plans need $150 minimum and charge $50 per plan, waived for CLB-only plans.
opts.w: 正确。账户管理费（Account Maintenance Fee）是集团奖学金计划独有的费用（该计划要求入组时未满 13 岁、最低月供 $9.50 或 1/10 单位取大者、销售费 $200/单位）；个人与家庭自主型计划均无账户管理费，最低认购均为 $150，销售费均为 $50/计划（自首笔供款扣清，仅为领取加拿大学习金 Canada Learning Bond, CLB 而开的计划免收）。

opts.t: The family self-determined plan allows unrelated beneficiaries of any age, whereas the group scholarship plan permits sharing of earnings and grants among multiple siblings under one contract.
opts.w: 错误。家庭自主型计划（Family Savings Plan）要求受益人均未满 21 岁且为认购人血缘或收养关联的子女、孙/外孙或曾孙，可在受益人间调配收益与补助；而集团计划每份协议仅限一名受益人，属于个人、家庭与集团计划特征互换陷阱。

main.pt: 集团计划转自主型计划与销售费退还
main.trap: 无损转换片面承诺陷阱
main.stem: A subscriber has held 10 units in the group scholarship plan for 13 years ($2,000 total sales charges paid). Her beneficiary is now age 19 and is considering taking a shorter 13-week full-time vocational program or possibly not attending post-secondary school at all. If the subscriber transfers the plan to a family self-determined plan today, what are the financial and contractual consequences?
main.zh: 一位认购人在集团奖学金计划中持有 10 个单位已满 13 年（共付销售费 $2,000）。其受益人现年 19 岁，正考虑只读一个 13 周的短期全日制职业课程，甚至可能完全不读高等教育。如果认购人今天将该计划转入家庭自主型计划，会产生怎样的财务与合同后果？

opts.t: 100% of net contributions, government grants, and accumulated income transfer with no transfer fee, and she qualifies for a 50% sales charge refund ($1,000) while keeping her units and attrition sharing rights.
opts.w: 错误。转入自主型计划后将立即失去全部单位和脱落分享权（Attrition Sharing Right），且 50% 销售费退还仅适用于留在集团计划走完全程并领满四笔 EAP 的情形（在组 13 年中途转出适用 12–15 年档的 20% 退费），属于无损转换片面承诺陷阱。

opts.t: Everything transfers with no fee, she gets a 20% sales charge refund ($400) paid in proportion to EAPs, and she gives up her units and her share of group attrition.
opts.w: 正确。在受益人年满 20 岁当年年末前（21 岁当年 1 月 1 日关门前）转入自主型计划，100% 净供款、政府补助及全部收益免手续费转入；在组 13 年落在 12–15 年档，可获 20%（$2,000 × 20% = $400）的部分销售费退还（Refund of Sales Charges），随从收益提取的 EAP 按比例支付；代价是丧失全部单位及脱落（Attrition）分享权，换取自主型计划下 13 周全日制即可取全部收益或提取累计收益（AIP）的灵活性。

opts.t: She cannot transfer the plan because the transfer window permanently closes on January 1 of the calendar year in which the beneficiary turns 18.
opts.w: 错误。转换窗口（Transfer Window）一直开到受益人年满 20 岁的那个日历年年末，在受益人年满 21 岁那年的 1 月 1 日才失效，19 岁完全来得及转，属于转换截止年龄记错陷阱。

opts.t: A $50 transfer fee is deducted from her contributions, all accumulated investment income is forfeited to the beneficiary group, and no sales charges are refunded.
opts.w: 错误。$50/次转出费及放弃销售费是转到其他注册教育储蓄计划提供商（External RESP Provider）的规则，而在本机构内部从集团计划转入自主型计划免收手续费、收益 100% 转入且享 0–25% 年限退费，属于内外部转户规则混淆陷阱。

main.pt: 魁北克停售新规与集体诉讼合规披露
main.trap: 考纲口径与现行新规错位陷阱
main.stem: In November 2026, a client residing in Quebec meets with a dealing representative to purchase units of the group scholarship plan and also asks about a news article mentioning a Quebec class action lawsuit over scholarship plan sales charges. Under the current prospectus disclosures, what must the representative tell the client?
main.zh: 2026 年 11 月，一位居住在魁北克的客户约见销售代表，打算购买集团奖学金计划单位，并询问一则关于魁北克奖学金计划销售费集体诉讼的新闻。根据现行招股书的披露，代表必须告知客户什么？

opts.t: The group scholarship plan has already been discontinued nationwide across all Canadian provinces, and the dealer settled the Quebec class action lawsuit in July 2025 for $634,072.
opts.w: 错误。集团奖学金计划（Group Scholarship Plan）并非全国停售（其余省份照常销售，魁省在 2026-12-31 前仍可购买），且 2025-07-14 签署 $634,072 和解协议的是同案另外三家被告，本机构并未和解，属于考纲口径与现行新规错位陷阱。

opts.t: The client can still purchase units in Quebec until December 31, 2026, and may continue adding new units to that existing plan after January 1, 2027, because the class action was dismissed by the court.
opts.w: 错误。2027-01-01 起魁北克不仅停售新计划单位，现有存量计划也不能再追加单位（Adding Units），且集体诉讼仍在按实体审理并未驳回，属于追加单位限制遗漏陷阱。

opts.t: She can buy until December 31, 2026; after that no new or added units in Quebec, though existing plans carry on, and a certified class action over Quebec sales charges is still pending with no predictable outcome.
opts.w: 正确。按 2026-01-28 现行招股书（Prospectus），2026-12-31 前魁省仍可购买集团计划单位，2027-01-01 起停止在魁省发售新单位且不得向现有计划追加单位，存量计划照旧管理；关于 2013-07-19 以来魁省销售费的集体诉讼（Class Action）中其他三家被告虽于 2025-07-14 和解，但本分销商与基金会未和解，代表只能客观陈述招股书事实而不预测结果。

opts.t: The representative can guarantee that the dealer will win the Quebec lawsuit and therefore waive the $200 per-unit sales charge for all Quebec residents enrolling before 2027.
opts.w: 错误。招股书在法律与行政程序（Legal and Administrative Proceedings）章节明确声明无法预测最终诉讼结果或时间，承诺必胜或擅自免除 $200/单位销售费均属严重违规，属于违规预测诉讼结果陷阱。

main.pt: 考试口径与2026招股书组织事实对照
main.trap: 考纲口径与现行新规错位陷阱
main.stem: When answering an exam question based on the 2020 training manual versus verifying facts in the 2026 prospectus, which set of organizational facts has remained UNCHANGED across both sources?
main.zh: 在对照基于 2020 年培训手册的考试口径与 2026 年招股书的现行实务时，下列哪一组组织事实在两个版本中均保持未变？（注：凡 2020 年手册考试口径与现行名称或人事有差异之处，考场按手册考试口径作答，实务对外一律以 2026 年招股书为准。）

opts.t: The corporate legal name of the distributor subsidiary, the identity of the President and CEO, and the inclusion of the legacy digital plan in the Independent Review Committee fee allocation.
opts.w: 错误。这三项在 2020 年手册与 2026 年招股书之间全部发生了变化：分销子公司已改名、总裁兼首席执行官（President and CEO）已于 2024 年 4 月换人、原线上计划已于 2021 年 12 月并入姊妹公司且从独立审查委员会（IRC）费用分摊名单中消失，属于考纲口径与现行新规错位陷阱。

opts.t: The foundation's 1960 founding, the subsidiary's 1988 start and 2010 IFM appointment, the unrelated trustee and custodian in place since 1996, and the external auditor.
opts.w: 正确。在 2020 年手册与 2026 年招股书中保持一致的核心事实包括：非营利基金会 1960 年成立、分销/管理子公司 1988 年设立运营并于 2010-09-28 获任投资基金经理（Investment Fund Manager, IFM）、与基金会及分销商无关联的独立受托人兼保管人（Trustee and Custodian）自 1996-03-01 起任职至今，以及独立外部审计师未变。

opts.t: The requirement that all six external portfolio managers must be wholly owned subsidiaries of the non-profit foundation.
opts.w: 错误。2026 年招股书列明的 6 家投资组合经理（Portfolio Managers）中，只有 1 家资产管理子公司是关联方，其余 5 家外部机构均与分销商及基金会无关联，属于关联关系以偏概全陷阱。

opts.t: The appointment of the external trustee company as the foundation's Transfer Agent and Registrar and the creation of seven standing board committees.
opts.w: 错误。过户与登记机构（Transfer Agent and Registrar）由非营利基金会本身担任而非外部受托公司，且手册口径下董事会常设委员会为 3 个（治理与人力资源、审计、投资）而非 7 个，属于角色与数字编造陷阱。

main.trap: 考纲口径与现行新规错位陷阱
main.stem: Three closely spaced historical milestones shaped the scholarship plan industry in Canada: 1967, 1972, and 1974. Which option correctly matches each year with the event tested on the exam?
main.zh: 1967 年、1972 年和 1974 年这三个年份相邻的历史里程碑深刻塑造了加拿大奖学金计划行业。下列哪一项正确对应了考试所考查的各年份事件？

opts.t: 1967: the organization became the sole national provider; 1972: scholarship plans were brought under provincial securities regulation; 1974: the first Educational Assistance Payments were distributed.
opts.w: 错误。1967 年与 1972 年的事件被对调了，且首次发放教育援助金（Educational Assistance Payments, EAPs）是在 1971 年而非 1974 年，属于相邻年份事件错位陷阱。

opts.t: 1967: tax deferral was granted by the tax authority; 1972: community colleges became eligible institutions; 1974: the for-profit distributor subsidiary was incorporated.
opts.w: 错误。争得递延纳税（Tax Deferral）是在 1974 年（追溯至 1972 年），合资格院校扩展至社区学院是在 1979-12-01，设立营利分销子公司是在 1988-09-01，属于全时间线混乱陷阱。

opts.t: 1967: the foundation was incorporated by Letters Patent; 1972: tax deferral was enacted; 1974: the third plan raised the maximum entry age from 10 to 13.
opts.w: 错误。基金会以专利特许状（Letters Patent）成立是在 1960-12-15，第三代计划将受益人入组年龄上限从 10 岁提高到 13 岁是在 1988 年，属于首尾年份混淆陷阱。

opts.t: 1967: a letter from the foundation's president to provincial attorneys general led to provincial securities regulation; 1972: sole national provider; 1974: tax deferral on earnings, retroactive to 1972.
opts.w: 正确。这三个相邻年份是高频考点：1967 年基金会时任总裁致函各省检察长指出十余家同业可能未保有足够准备金，促成奖学金信托计划被纳入各省证券监管（Provincial Securities Regulation）；1972 年该机构成为全国唯一提供奖学金协议的机构；1974 年从税务部门争得计划收益递延纳税（Tax Deferral）待遇并追溯至 1972 年，使收益改在受益人领取 EAP 时计入受益人所得。

variants.pt: 两部分招股书的交付、更新与摘要规则
variants.trap: 从业代表私收费与财报月寄陷阱
variants.stem: A dealing representative is preparing the enrollment package for a client who is purchasing units in one of three scholarship plans managed by the same foundation. Which document delivery rule applies?
variants.zh: 一位从业代表正在为客户准备开户文件包，该客户购买的是同一家基金会管理的三款奖学金计划之一。以下哪项文件交付规则适用？

opts.t: Deliver the Detailed Plan Disclosure together with the Plan Summary (four pages or fewer, in plain language) for the specific plan the client is buying.
opts.w: 正确。认购人必须同时收到 Detailed Plan Disclosure 和他所认购的那一个具体计划的 Plan Summary（不超过 4 页，平实语言），两份缺一不可且不能给错计划版本。

opts.t: The representative only needs to email a link to SEDAR+ because both parts of the prospectus are incorporated by reference.
opts.w: 交付义务错误：招股书的两部分（Plan Summary 与 Detailed Plan Disclosure）必须实际交付给每一位认购人；只有财报、MRFP 和 IRC 年报才是以引用方式并入（incorporated by reference）。

opts.t: The representative must deliver the Plan Summary at signing and mail the monthly updated Detailed Plan Disclosure every 30 days.
opts.w: 更新与交付时间错误：两部分招股书都在开户时交付，且招股书按年续期，不存在每 30 天按月更新寄送的规则。

opts.t: The representative may skip the Plan Summary if the client signs a written waiver confirming he has read the 70-page Detailed Plan Disclosure.
opts.w: 强制披露不可豁免：NI 41-101 强制要求交付 Plan Summary 且代表应在签字前带客户走一遍摘要，客户签字也不能豁免交付义务。

variants.pt: 招股书收据与CRA批准的真实含义
variants.trap: 政府背书陷阱
variants.stem: Which statement regarding SEDAR+ and regulatory oversight of scholarship plans is true?
variants.zh: 关于 SEDAR+ 与奖学金计划的监管，以下哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: SEDAR+ is the federal regulatory agency that audits scholarship plans and issues receipts approving them as safe investments.
opts.w: 平台属性与背书双重错误：SEDAR+ 是文件备案与检索系统而非监管机构；发出 receipt 的是各省证监会，且 receipt 也不是安全投资背书。

opts.t: Distribution in a province requires that province's receipt first, and anyone can view the filed disclosure documents free of charge on SEDAR+.
opts.w: 正确。没有取得某省证监会对招股书发出的 receipt，不得在该省向公众分销；备案后的招股书、年报、财报等法定披露文件，公众均可在 www.sedarplus.ca（SEDAR+）免费在线查阅。

opts.t: SEDAR+ administers the Canada Education Savings Grant (CESG) and restricts document access to registered dealing representatives only.
opts.w: 张冠李戴：SEDAR+ 既不管理 CESG 补助项目，也不是只对从业代表开放——它对所有公众免费开放。

opts.t: Once a plan is uploaded to SEDAR+, the representative may tell clients that the government has endorsed the plan's expected EAP payouts.
opts.w: 政府背书陷阱：无论是否在 SEDAR+ 备案或取得 receipt，任何声称政府或证监会背书、认可计划收益的话术都是直接违反证券法的行为。

variants.pt: 四张法定财报与净资产变动表的流入流出
variants.trap: EAP 资金流向反转
variants.stem: A subscriber asks which part of the annual financial statements shows the scholarship plan's assets minus liabilities at a specific point in time, and where post-maturity pool earnings used to supplement EAPs are explained. Which answer is correct?
variants.zh: 一位认购人询问：年度财务报表的哪一部分显示奖学金计划在特定时点的「资产减负债」，以及到期后资金池收益用于补充 EAP 的机制在哪里说明？以下哪项回答正确？

opts.t: The Statement of Operations shows assets minus liabilities, and the Statement of Investment Portfolio explains the General Fund.
opts.w: 报表功能混淆：经营表（Statement of Operations）反映的是一段期间的投资收益与费用支出，投资组合表（Statement of Investment Portfolio）列出的是逐笔持仓明细。

opts.t: The Statement of Changes in Net Assets shows the point-in-time balance sheet, and the IRC Annual Report manages the General Fund.
opts.w: 报表与机构混淆：净资产变动表反映的是一段期间的资金流入与流出，而非时点资产负债表；IRC 负责审查利益冲突，不管理 General Fund。

opts.t: The Statement of Net Assets is mailed monthly to show assets minus liabilities, while the Plan Summary audits the General Fund.
opts.w: 寄送频率错误：净资产表虽是资产负债表，但属于年度审计财报的一部分（以引用方式并入招股书），绝不会按月寄给认购人。

opts.t: The Statement of Net Assets shows assets minus liabilities at a point in time; the Notes to the Financial Statements explain the General Fund.
opts.w: 正确。净资产表（Statement of Net Assets）本质上就是计划在某一时点的资产负债表（净资产 = 资产 − 负债）；财报附注（Notes to the Financial Statements）涵盖 General Fund（一般基金），即某个 pool 到期日之后的全部投资收益记入该基金，用于抵销部分计划费用并补充 EAP 水平。

variants.pt: 管理费区间与供款完成保险的保障对象
variants.trap: 保险保障对象错位
variants.stem: A subscriber purchases optional completion insurance when enrolling in a group scholarship plan, then decides to cancel the plan on day 120. What happens to the completion insurance policy and the premiums already paid?
variants.zh: 一位认购人在加入集团奖学金计划时购买了可选的供款完成保险，随后在签约第 120 天决定取消计划。供款完成保险保单及已缴保费会怎样？

opts.t: All insurance premiums paid are refunded in full because completion insurance is held in a segregated account.
opts.w: 时限与账户混淆：只有签约 60 天内退出才能退还已缴保费；第 120 天已超过 60 天窗口，且隔离账户（segregated account）是用于销售费退还承诺，不是退保费的。

opts.t: The policy automatically converts into a permanent life insurance policy on the beneficiary's life.
opts.w: 保险对象与性质错误：供款完成保险（completion insurance）保障的是认购人身故或失能时的剩余供款，既不保受益人性命，也不是终身寿险组合。

opts.t: Because cancellation came after the 60-day window, the insurance premiums already paid are lost along with any investment income.
opts.w: 正确。签约 60 天内退出，已付保险费全额退还；但在 60 天之后（如第 120 天）终止计划，已缴的供款完成保险保费（completion insurance premiums）一并归于损失，仅退回净供款。

opts.t: The dealing representative must personally refund 50% of the insurance premiums from the representative's annual administration fee.
opts.w: 无中生有：从业代表既不向客户收年度管理费，也不承担退还客户保费的个人义务。

variants.pt: 按单位计价的销售费前置扣除节奏与计算
variants.trap: 销售费平摊错觉
variants.stem: A subscriber enrols in a group scholarship plan with a monthly contribution of $250 and a total unit-based sales charge of $1,500. Under the standard foundation deduction schedule, how many total months will it take to pay off the entire $1,500 sales charge?
variants.zh: 一位认购人加入集团奖学金计划，每月供款 $250，按单位计价的总销售费为 $1,500。按照基金会的标准扣除节奏，总共需要多少个月才能付清全部 $1,500 的销售费？

opts.t: 6 months, because 100% of every $250 monthly contribution is applied to the sales charge until the full $1,500 is paid.
opts.w: 混淆两段扣费规则：100% 全额扣除只持续到销售费付掉一半（$750，即前 3 个月），后一半 $750 必须按每笔供款的 50%（每月 $125）扣除。

opts.t: 9 months: 3 months at the full $250 to cover the first $750, then 6 months at $125 (half of each contribution) for the remaining $750.
opts.w: 正确。总销售费（sales charge）$1,500 的一半是 $750：第一阶段按每月供款 $250 的 100% 扣除，需 $750 ÷ $250 = 3 个月（这 3 个月进本金为 $0）；第二阶段按每月供款的 50%（即 $125／月）扣除剩余 $750，需 $750 ÷ $125 = 6 个月。两段合计 3 + 6 = 9 个月付清。

opts.t: 12 months, because exactly 50% of every contribution ($125/month) is applied to the sales charge from the very first month.
opts.w: 销售费平摊错觉：前 3 个月是按 100%（$250／月）扣除前一半销售费，并非从第一个月起就按 50% 扣除。

opts.t: 15 months, because only $100 per month can legally be deducted toward sales charges under NI 41-101.
opts.w: 捏造法规上限：NI 41-101 规范的是招股书与 Plan Summary 的披露格式，并未设定每月 $100 的销售费扣除上限。

variants.pt: 60天内外退出的费用、补助额度与合规动作
variants.trap: 销售费平摊错觉
variants.stem: A client calls her dealing representative on day 48 after signing a scholarship plan contract and says she wants to withdraw from the plan. What must the dealing representative do?
variants.zh: 一位客户在签署奖学金计划合同后的第 48 天致电从业代表，表示想要退出计划。从业代表必须怎么做？

opts.t: Schedule a follow-up meeting two weeks later (on day 62) to review the Plan Summary again before accepting the withdrawal form.
opts.w: 严重合规红线：任何以拖延手段消耗客户 60 天无条件退出窗口（拖到第 61 天及以后）的行为，都是可被直接立案的违规。

opts.t: Warn the client that withdrawing on day 48 will permanently destroy the child's CESG grant contribution room.
opts.w: 混淆 60 天内外后果：60 天内属于无条件全额撤销，60 天之后取消计划并退回补助才会导致除 CLB 外的补助额度损失。

opts.t: Process the withdrawal promptly, without stalling, so the client gets a full refund, including sales charges and any insurance premiums paid.
opts.w: 正确。第 48 天仍在签约后 60 天无条件退出窗口内（60-day withdrawal right），客户有权拿回全部已付款项（含已扣销售费与保险费）；代表必须当场协助走完退出流程，不得劝阻或拖延到第 61 天。

opts.t: Deduct the first month's sales charge and depository fee, then refund the remaining net contribution.
opts.w: 扣费错误：60 天内退出的退费范围是 100% 全额退回，包括已付的销售费与各项费用，不得扣除首月销售费或存管费。

variants.pt: 销售费退还双路径与资格条件
variants.trap: 销售费平摊错觉
variants.stem: A subscriber stays in the group scholarship plan until maturity and makes all scheduled contributions, but her child enrolls in a two-year program and collects only two of the four available EAPs. How much of the sales charge is refunded, and how is the refund taxed?
variants.zh: 一位认购人留在集团奖学金计划直至到期并交齐了全部应缴供款，但她的孩子就读于两年制项目，四笔可用 EAP 中只领到了两笔。销售费能退还多少？该笔退还款如何征税？

opts.t: 50% of the sales charge is refunded because all contributions were paid to maturity, and the refund is taxed in the subscriber's hands.
opts.w: 比例与税务均错：退还笔数不能超过实际领取的 EAP 笔数，只领两笔 EAP 只能退 25%（而非 50%）；且销售费退还对认购人与受益人都不构成应税收入。

opts.t: 0% is refunded because all four EAPs must be collected to receive any refund at all, and the forfeited amount is taxed as an AIP.
opts.w: 全有或全无错觉：并非少拿一笔 EAP 就连前两笔也归零——每领一笔 EAP 就退还该单位销售费的 12.5%，领两笔可退 25%；只有完全不符合 EAP 资格（0 笔 EAP）时才一分钱拿不到。

opts.t: 25% (12.5% with each of the two EAPs collected), and the refund is not taxable income to either the subscriber or the beneficiary.
opts.w: 正确。每笔 EAP 退还该单位已付销售费的 12.5%，退还笔数不能超过 EAP 笔数；四笔 EAP 只拿两笔时，销售费退还也只拿两笔，共 25%（12.5% × 2），且退还款对认购人与受益人都不构成应税收入（not taxable income）。

opts.t: 25% of the sales charge plus all compound interest earned on the sales charge in the segregated account is refunded and taxed in the student's hands.
opts.w: 收益归属与税务错误：隔离账户（segregated account）每两年估值由基金会兜底缺口，但退还给客户的金额不含销售费所产生的收益（does not include income earned on the sales charges），且退还款本身不征税。

variants.pt: 区分KYC与适合性评估两项独立义务
variants.trap: KYC与适合性概念偷换
variants.stem: During a compliance audit, a supervisor notes that a dealing representative accurately recorded a subscriber's income, net worth, investment knowledge, risk profile, and time horizon on the application form, but recommended a contribution schedule that consumes most of the family's disposable income. Which specific obligation did the representative fail to fulfill properly?
variants.zh: 在合规审计中，主管发现从业代表在申请表上准确记录了认购人的收入、净资产、投资知识、风险画像和投资期限，但却推荐了一个占用该家庭大部分可支配收入的供款计划。代表未能妥善履行哪一项具体义务？

opts.t: The Suitability Assessment obligation, including the requirement to ensure and document that the subscriber can reasonably afford continuous scheduled contributions.
opts.w: 正确。代表已完成了收集与记录事实的了解你的客户（KYC）步骤，但在用事实做判断的适合性评估（Suitability Assessment）及奖学金计划特有的可负担性（Affordability）评估上失职。

opts.t: The Know Your Client (KYC) obligation, because recording accurate financial facts is the same legal step as deciding which product to recommend.
opts.w: 错误。这是「KYC与适合性概念偷换」陷阱。KYC 负责收集与记录五维度事实，题干明确指出代表已准确记录这些事实，出问题的是后续用事实做判断的适合性评估环节。

opts.t: The Trusted Contact Person (TCP) obligation, because the representative should have contacted a family member before finalizing a high contribution amount.
opts.w: 错误。可信联系人（Trusted Contact Person, TCP）仅在怀疑客户遭受财务剥削或心智能力下降等特定情形下依书面同意联系，不用于常规开户的可负担性审批。

opts.t: The Know Your Product (KYP) obligation, which requires the dealer to monitor changes in the scholarship plan's underlying portfolio holdings.
opts.w: 错误。了解你的产品（Know Your Product, KYP）要求理解产品结构与成本并只销售已批准产品；本题症结在于未结合客户财务状况评估可负担性，属于适合性评估（Suitability Assessment）缺失。

variants.pt: KYC不可豁免与拒绝提供信息的处理
variants.trap: 客户自愿豁免与人情诱因
variants.stem: When an existing scholarship plan account is reassigned to a dealing representative from a colleague who recently left the dealer, what KYC standard applies to the receiving representative?
variants.zh: 当一个现有的奖学金计划账户从近期离职的同事手中转接到一位从业代表名下时，接收该账户的代表适用什么样的 KYC 标准？

opts.t: No KYC review is required until three years have elapsed from the date the former representative originally opened the account.
opts.w: 错误。账户从同事手上转到你名下时，不能坐等原定的 3 年复核周期，必须在接手时立即履行核实义务。

opts.t: A simplified standard applies where the representative only needs to verify that the subscriber's banking transit and account numbers remain active.
opts.w: 错误。转接账户不存在所谓的简化标准，仅核对银行账号远不足以满足了解你的客户（KYC）和持续适合性要求。

opts.t: The representative may rely entirely on the former colleague's handwritten notes as long as the subscriber signs a waiver of re-verification.
opts.w: 错误。这是「客户自愿豁免与人情诱因」陷阱。客户无权豁免 KYC 义务，接收代表也不能盲目依赖前任记录而不与客户互动。

opts.t: The same KYC standard as for a new client: review the data, discuss it with the client, and learn why the account moved and what service is expected.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径明确规定，账户从同事手上转到你名下时，必须适用与新客户完全相同的了解你的客户（KYC）标准——复核数据、与客户进行有意义的讨论、了解转移原因以及客户对你的服务期待。

variants.pt: 重大利益冲突处理与佣金返还四禁令
variants.trap: 客户自愿豁免与人情诱因
variants.stem: A dealing representative is authorized to offer two scholarship plan options that are equally suitable for a client's objectives and risk profile, but one plan pays the representative a higher commission while charging the client higher fees. How must the representative handle this conflict of interest?
variants.zh: 一位从业代表获准提供两种对客户的目标和风险画像同样合适的奖学金计划选项，但其中一种计划向代表支付更高的佣金，同时向客户收取更高的费用。代表必须如何处理这一利益冲突？

opts.t: Recommend the lower-cost plan, since the conflict must be managed in the client's best interest regardless of the representative's own pay.
opts.w: 正确。根据利益冲突（Conflict of Interest）规则与《道德守则》（Code of Ethics）原则一，代表须提供客观公正的信息而不考虑自身报酬；若存在同样合适但客户费用更低的产品，就应当推荐那个低费用产品。

opts.t: Recommend the higher-commission plan as long as the commission rate is printed inside the standard account opening form signed by the client.
opts.w: 错误。监管明确强调，所谓向客户披露利益冲突，不止是把信息写进开户表或其他书面文件；更重要的是必须以客户最佳利益（Client's Best Interest）管理冲突，不能仅靠填表就推荐高费率劣势产品。

opts.t: Recommend the higher-commission plan and offset the difference by paying the client's first monthly deposit out of the representative's own pocket.
opts.w: 错误。这是「客户自愿豁免与人情诱因」陷阱。代表代客户支付部分或全部销售费或存款属于四条禁令之一，严禁实施。

opts.t: Implement a personal fee-splitting arrangement immediately and notify the dealer's compliance officer during the annual account review.
opts.w: 错误。代表对利益冲突的三个标准动作是：识别并向经销商报告、以客户最佳利益评估并管理、在实施任何拟议做法前先等经销商批准，绝不能自作主张搞私下分成。

variants.pt: 客户投诉处理时限与争议升级渠道
variants.trap: DNCL与CASL时间窗口互换
variants.stem: Which of the following statements accurately describes how customer complaints and third-party dispute resolution work for a scholarship plan dealer?
variants.zh: 下列哪项陈述准确描述了奖学金计划经销商的客户投诉处理与第三方争议解决机制？

opts.t: Only written complaints must be logged and addressed, whereas oral complaints made by telephone can be resolved informally without documentation.
opts.w: 错误。根据《国家文书 31-103》（NI 31-103 s.13.15），口头与书面投诉都要记录、都要及时专业处理，口头投诉应与书面投诉同等重视。

opts.t: Independent dispute resolution is provided at the dealer's expense, and for a subscriber living in Quebec the third-party body is the AMF, not OBSI.
opts.w: 正确。关系披露（Relationship Disclosure）明确指出独立争议解决服务由经销商承担费用提供；在投诉规则的两条例外中，居住在魁北克省的客户，其第三方争议解决机构是魁北克金融市场管理局（AMF），而不是银行服务与投资监察专员（OBSI）。

opts.t: A subscriber who accepts a settlement offer from the dealer retains the right to escalate the same complaint to OBSI within 180 days for additional compensation.
opts.w: 错误。投诉处理规则明确规定了两条例外之一：认购人一旦接受（Accepts）和解方案，OBSI 程序即不再适用。

opts.t: Complaints regarding personal financial dealings between a representative and a client do not require a written substantive response from the dealer.
opts.w: 错误。与客户之间的个人财务往来（Personal Financial Dealings）属于必须作出书面初步回复与实质回复的六类核心投诉之一（其余五类为：交易或建议行为、违反客户保密、盗窃/欺诈/挪用/伪造、虚假陈述、未披露或被禁止的利益冲突）。

variants.pt: 道德守则与跨会员转移计划的处理
variants.trap: 集团计划跨机构转移的理由误判
variants.stem: During a presentation to a prospective subscriber who holds a scholarship plan with a competing dealer, how must a dealing representative conduct any discussion regarding the competitor's plan under the RESPDAC Code of Ethics?
variants.zh: 在向一位持有竞争对手经销商奖学金计划的潜在认购人作介绍时，根据 RESPDAC《道德守则》，从业代表必须如何进行任何有关竞争对手计划的讨论？

opts.t: The representative may use self-prepared comparison charts as long as the calculations are explained orally to the subscriber.
opts.w: 错误。根据《道德守则》（Code of Ethics）原则三，讨论本方或竞争对手的注册教育储蓄计划时，只能使用本会员出版或批准的书面产品资料，严禁使用自制未批准的对比图表。

opts.t: The representative is grandfathered from the Code of Ethics restrictions if they have been continuously registered since September 28, 2009.
opts.w: 错误。2009-09-28 的祖父豁免仅针对《国家文书 31-103》（NI 31-103 s.3.7）的一次性资格考试要求；RESPDAC《道德守则》（2022-11-24 经董事会批准）对所有代表均具约束力，不存在老代表祖父豁免。

opts.t: Stay objective and fair, never disparage the competitor, and use only written product material published or approved by his own member firm.
opts.w: 正确。根据《道德守则》（Code of Ethics）原则三，代表不得就另一代表、另一会员或任何产品作出虚假、误导、不准确或不完整的评论，讨论竞争对手须客观公平、不得贬损（Disparage），且讨论本方或竞争对手的 RESP 时只能使用本会员出版或批准的书面产品资料。

opts.t: The representative should highlight only the competitor's early termination penalties while omitting the sales charges of the representative's own plan.
opts.w: 错误。这同时违反了原则一（在签署合同前准确完整说明本方 enrolment fee 及提前终止影响）与原则三（客观公平、不作不完整或误导性对比）以及广告比较须公平纳入双方相关事实的规则。

variants.pt: 销售沟通标准与业绩数据180天时限
variants.trap: 口头沟通不受广告规则约束
variants.stem: A dealing representative wants to order new business cards and stationery to promote his scholarship plan practice. Which of the following is required under the standards for business cards and stationery?
variants.zh: 一位从业代表想印制新的名片和信笺来推广其奖学金计划业务。根据名片与信笺的合规标准，下列哪一项是必须遵守的要求？

opts.t: The representative may print a self-created trade name on the cards without prior permission as long as his personal phone number is active for 60 days.
opts.w: 错误。未经事先批准，代表不得在销售沟通、名片或信笺中使用任何其他商号（Trade Name）；60 天联系方式有效期是《加拿大反垃圾邮件法》（CASL）对商业电子讯息的要求。

opts.t: The cards may be used for both the representative's scholarship plan business and an unrelated side business to save printing costs.
opts.w: 错误。名片与信笺六条标准明确规定，其使用仅限代表经销商的业务往来，不得混用于其他无关业务。

opts.t: The representative may adopt an executive title that sounds more senior than his registration category to build trust with prospective subscribers.
opts.w: 错误。代表不得就资质或头衔误导投资者，只能使用经经销商授权且公平反映其注册状态与职能的头衔。

opts.t: They must disclose the dealer's full legal name alongside the representative's name, authorized title, and business address, and follow the dealer's policies.
opts.w: 正确。名片与信笺六条标准要求：按经销商政策制作使用、仅限代表经销商的业务往来、不得就资质或头衔误导投资者、须披露经销商完整法定名称（Full Legal Name）及你的姓名、职衔、营业地址、只能用经销商授权且公平反映注册状态与职能的头衔、未经批准不得使用其他商号。

variants.pt: DNCL电话规则与CASL反垃圾邮件法
variants.trap: DNCL与CASL时间窗口互换
variants.stem: A dealing representative is planning a telemarketing campaign to contact prospective subscribers who have no prior relationship with the dealer, and also plans to send commercial electronic messages (CEMs) to prospects who gave express consent. Which set of rules must the representative follow?
variants.zh: 一位从业代表计划开展电话营销活动，联系与经销商无既有关系的潜在认购人，同时计划向已给予明示同意的潜在客户发送商业电子讯息（CEM）。代表必须遵守哪一组规则？

opts.t: Call only 9:00–21:30 weekdays or 10:00–18:00 weekends (local time), skip National and internal DNCL numbers, and give each CEM contact details valid 60 days plus an immediate unsubscribe.
opts.w: 正确。电话营销须注册订阅《全国拒接来电名单》（National DNCL）并自建内部名单、不得致电两份名单上的号码、表明身份，且只能在潜在客户当地时间周一至周五 9:00–21:30、周六与周日 10:00–18:00 致电；发送商业电子讯息（CEM）须包含姓名/企业名称/邮寄地址、自发出起至少有效 60 天的电话/电邮/网址，以及即时生效的免费退订链接。

opts.t: Disguise the telemarketing calls as an educational survey to get around the National DNCL restrictions, and keep the CEM contact details active for at least 10 days.
opts.w: 错误。把销售电话伪装成问卷调查属于对来电性质与目的作虚假陈述，是明确列出的四类冷呼（Cold Calling）滥用行为之一；且 CEM 中的联系方式必须至少有效 60 天而非 10 天。

opts.t: Call prospects between 9:00 and 21:30 on Saturdays and Sundays, and send a follow-up email confirming whenever a recipient clicks the unsubscribe link in a CEM.
opts.w: 错误。周六与周日的许可致电时段是 10:00–18:00（9:00–21:30 仅限周一至周五）；且收到 CEM 退订请求后严禁再发一封邮件确认退订已处理。

opts.t: Obtain express consent only in writing because oral opt-in is invalid under CASL, and note that CRTC penalties apply only to corporations and never to individual representatives.
opts.w: 错误。根据《加拿大反垃圾邮件法》（CASL），明示同意（Express Consent）需主动 opt-in，但可口头或书面取得；此外 CRTC 罚则对个人同样适用（个人最高 $1,000,000，企业最高 $10,000,000）。

variants.pt: CSA与NI的法律性质
variants.trap: 把协调协会或自律组织当成直管机关
variants.stem: During a team study session, a trainee claims that the Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA) fined an unlicensed representative last month under a federal securities act. Why is the trainee's statement incorrect?
variants.zh: 在一次小组学习中，一名学员声称加拿大证券管理局（CSA）上个月依据一部联邦证券法对一名无牌代表进行了罚款。为什么该学员的说法是错误的？

opts.t: Because only the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) can levy fines against scholarship plan dealing representatives under federal law.
opts.w: 错误。CIRO 既不依据联邦证券法执法，也完全不管辖奖学金计划经销商（SPD）及其交易代表。

opts.t: Because the CSA only prosecutes criminal fraud in federal court and delegates administrative fines to municipal authorities.
opts.w: 错误。CSA 是非正式协调协会，没有任何起诉或行政处罚权，证券监管也不归市政当局管辖。

opts.t: Canada has no federal securities act or regulator; only a provincial or territorial commission can register or penalize market participants.
opts.w: 正确。加拿大宪法将证券监管归入省级管辖权，没有联邦证券法；CSA 只负责协调与起草统一规则，真正拥有注册、调查和罚款执法权的永远是 13 家省或地区证监会中的具体某一家。

opts.t: Because the CSA can only suspend registrations in the three territories, while the ten provinces enforce rules through the federal Department of Finance.
opts.w: 错误。三个地区（育空、西北地区、努纳武特）与十个省一样各自设有独立的证券监管机构，CSA 在任何省或地区都没有直接停牌权。

variants.pt: 交易定义与抢跑禁令
variants.trap: 误以为只有正式签单收款才算证券法下的交易
variants.stem: Which of the following activities falls within the statutory definition of 'trading' under Canadian provincial securities legislation, thereby requiring prior registration?
variants.zh: 根据加拿大省级证券法规，下列哪项活动属于法定的「交易（trading）」定义范围，从而必须事先取得注册？

opts.t: An administrative clerk mailing an annual cost report to existing subscribers without discussing account changes.
opts.w: 错误。纯行政人员按规定寄送后台年度报表、不涉及任何招揽或促成交易的磋商，不属于 trading。

opts.t: An information technology contractor updating the dealer's internal server security software.
opts.w: 错误。IT 维护工作与证券买卖或招揽客户无关，不属于证券法定义的 trading。

opts.t: A subscriber transferring personal funds between their own chequing and savings accounts at a bank.
opts.w: 错误。认购人在银行自己的支票账户与储蓄账户之间划转存款，不涉及发行或促成证券交易。

opts.t: Meeting prospective subscribers at a café to compare scholarship plan options and encourage them to open an account.
opts.w: 正确。在咖啡厅向潜在客户介绍比较计划、争取对方开户，属于为促成一笔交易而作的行为、招揽或磋商（any act, solicitation, or negotiation in furtherance of a trade），直接落入证券法下 trading 的法定定义，必须持牌方可进行。

variants.pt: 跨省注册与10天报备
variants.trap: 以办公地代替客户居住地判断注册辖区
variants.stem: Under National Instrument 33-109, which of the following changes to a dealing representative's registration information is subject to a 30-day reporting deadline rather than the standard 10-day deadline?
variants.zh: 根据《全国性文件 33-109》（NI 33-109），交易代表注册信息的下列哪项变更适用 30 天报备时限，而非标准的 10 天时限？

opts.t: A change in citizenship or updates to previous employment history.
opts.w: 正确。依 NI 33-109，大多数重大事项（姓名、住址、外部业务、涉诉、破产、纪律处分等）均须在 10 天内报备，只有少数特定事项——如国籍变更（change in citizenship）和过往受雇经历（previous employment）——适用 30 天内报备的时限。

opts.t: Filing a consumer proposal or declaring personal bankruptcy.
opts.w: 错误。破产、消费者提案（consumer proposal）或工资扣押直接关系到注册人的财务诚信与适任性，必须严格在 10 天内通过 NRD 报备。

opts.t: Taking on an unpaid volunteer treasurer role at a local community association.
opts.w: 错误。新增或变更外部业务或受雇活动（无论是否有报酬，whether compensated or not），都必须在 10 天内报备，而非 30 天。

opts.t: A change in personal hair colour or body weight.
opts.w: 错误。头发颜色、体重这类纯个人外貌特征属于不必更新（no need to update）的事项，既不是 10 天也不是 30 天。

variants.pt: SPD直管与CIRO边界
variants.trap: 把协调协会或自律组织当成直管机关
variants.stem: An education savings group operates two separate subsidiary corporations in the same building: Firm X is registered solely as a Scholarship Plan Dealer, while Firm Y holds dual registration as both a Scholarship Plan Dealer and a Mutual Fund Dealer. Which regulator(s) oversee Firm X and Firm Y?
variants.zh: 一家教育储蓄集团在同一栋楼里运营两家独立的子公司：X 公司仅注册为奖学金计划经销商，而 Y 公司持有奖学金计划经销商与共同基金交易商双重注册。X 公司和 Y 公司分别受谁监管？

opts.t: Both Firm X and Firm Y are regulated exclusively by CIRO because they share the same corporate parent.
opts.w: 错误。决定监管归属的是每个法人实体自身的注册类别（registration category），而不是母公司名字或办公地点；X 公司没有共同基金或投资交易商牌照，不在 CIRO 内。

opts.t: Firm X is overseen directly by the provincial and territorial commissions, while Firm Y is a CIRO Dealer Member because of its mutual fund dealer registration.
opts.w: 正确。仅注册为奖学金计划经销商（SPD）的 X 公司由省或地区证监会直管，不入 CIRO；而 Y 公司因为持有共同基金交易商（Mutual Fund Dealer）注册，属于 CIRO 的交易商会员（Dealer Member）。

opts.t: Firm X is regulated by FINTRAC as its primary securities regulator, while Firm Y is regulated by the Canada Revenue Agency.
opts.w: 错误。FINTRAC 管反洗钱报告，CRA 管税法下的样本计划注册，两者都不是证券监管机构。

opts.t: Neither firm is subject to CIRO oversight because any firm offering Registered Education Savings Plans is exempt from self-regulatory organizations.
opts.w: 错误。只要公司持有共同基金交易商（Mutual Fund Dealer）注册（如 Y 公司），即使卖的是共同基金形态的 RESP，也必须作为 CIRO 会员受其监管。

variants.pt: 招股书收据与60天撤回权
variants.trap: 把招股书收据当成政府认可或批准投资价值
variants.stem: A scholarship plan dealer mails the current prospectus to a new subscriber by regular mail (not registered mail). Under the prospectus delivery rules, when must the prospectus be sent, when is the subscriber deemed to have received it, and what happens if the dealer never delivers it?
variants.zh: 一家奖学金计划经销商通过普通平邮（非挂号信）向新认购人寄送现行招股书。根据招股书交付规则，招股书最迟须在何时寄出？认购人何时被视为收到？如果经销商一直未交付会有什么后果？

opts.t: Sent within 10 days of signing; deemed received on the 15th day; failure to deliver results only in a minor administrative warning.
opts.w: 错误。10 天和 15 天分别是注册变更与 LCTR 的时限；未送达招股书不仅导致取消权持续存在，购买人还对未送达的经销商享有损害赔偿或撤销协议的法定诉权。

opts.t: Sent before midnight on the fifth business day after signing; deemed received immediately upon mailing; and failure to deliver simply extends the withdrawal period to 90 days.
opts.w: 错误。法定最迟交付期限是第 2 个营业日午夜而非第 5 个营业日，普通平邮也不是寄出即视为收到，更没有 90 天的规定。

opts.t: Sent within 60 days of the lapse date; deemed received on the 30th day; failure to deliver transfers liability solely to the plan promoter.
opts.w: 错误。过了失效日（lapse date）根本不得再据以销售证券，且未送达招股书的责任直接由未履行交付义务的经销商（dealer）承担。

opts.t: Within two business days (by midnight); deemed received on day 7 after mailing; if never delivered, an ongoing right to cancel plus a right of action against the dealer.
opts.w: 正确。招股书最迟须在签订购买协议后第 2 个营业日午夜前交付（多数经销商要求首次介绍或入会时即交付）；普通平邮视为寄出后第 7 天收到；若未交付，60 天撤回权时钟永不起算，认购人享有持续的取消权（ongoing right to cancel）及起诉未送达经销商要求赔偿或撤销协议的权利。

variants.pt: 证监会执法权的边界
variants.trap: 误以为证监会能直接判令赔偿或强迫客户履约
variants.stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes administrative enforcement by a provincial securities commission from criminal or quasi-criminal prosecution in court?
variants.zh: 下列哪项正确区分了省级证监会的行政执法与通过法院进行的刑事或准刑事起诉？

opts.t: Administrative enforcement can impose prison sentences of up to 14 years without any court trial, whereas the courts are limited to issuing cease-trade orders.
opts.w: 错误。监禁（imprisonment）只能由法院在定罪后判处，行政机关无权判处监禁；而停止交易令（cease-trade order）是证监会的行政工具。
